evidence.readmeExcerpt:
# dsh-wallet

Wallet capability seam for DeepSeek Harness: `ctx.wallet` runs named wallets
over pluggable chain adapters. Configuration carries a credential *reference*
(`keyRef`, resolved through `ctx.credentials`), never a key — the secret value
exists only inside one operation, between resolution and the adapter call.

Concept lineage: haven-core's `WalletIdentity` machine ("the private key NEVER
leaves this machine boundary — other machines request signatures, they don't
access keys") and its `CryptoAdapter` port, translated to dsh seams. Haven's
`loadKey("env:VAR" | "0x…")` string is replaced by the dsh credential seam:
references in config, values at the operation boundary. There is no raw-key
config path at all — a pasted key fails the `CredentialRef` pattern at plugin
load with an actionable error.

## Install

```sh
dsh plugin --profile <name> add /path/to/dsh-wallet
```

The package declares `dsh.bundle`, so installing it activates its
`cordis.patch.yml` layer (one `wallet` row over `dsh-base`, whose
`credentials` row supplies the provider). Configure wallets in your profile's
`cordis.patch.yml`:

```yaml
- id: wallet
  config:
    wallets:
      treasury:
        chain: evm
        wallet: agent-treasury           # provider-scoped selector (e.g. OWS vault wallet name)
        keyRef: HAVEN_WALLET_PASSPHRASE  # credential REFERENCE — never a key
```

Install one adapter bundle per chain family you sign on (e.g.
[`dsh-wallet-ethereum`](../dsh-wallet-ethereum/README.md) for `evm`).

## API

Service `ctx.wallet` (`WalletRuntime`, injects `credentials`):

- `register(chain, adapter): () => void` — provider registration with a
  stale-safe disposer. `adapter` implements the `CryptoAdapter` contract
  (`loadKey(source)` / `signMessage(keyMaterial, payload)` /
  `signTransaction(keyMaterial, payload)`; see `src/types.ts`).
- `list(): WalletInfo[]` — configured wallets with configuration facts only
  (`keyRefConfigured`, `adapterRegistered`); never secrets.
- `address(name): Promise<WalletAddress>` — derive the public address.
- `signMessage(name, payload)` / `signTransaction(name, payload)` —
  `Promise<{ address, signature }>`. Sign-only: broadcasting belongs to
  whoever holds the signed payload.
- `withLock(name, task)` — run `task` in the wallet's exclusive lane.
  Same-wallet tasks run strictly in call order, so a fetch-nonce →
  sign → send sequence wrapped here cannot share a nonce with a
  concurrent sender; different wallets proceed independently.

Every operation runs resolve → `loadKey` → sign → drop: `ctx.credentials
.resolve(keyRef)` is called inside the operation (never cached, per the
credentials-seam contract), the resolved value rides the operation-scoped
`WalletKeySource`, and no reference to it or to adapter `keyMaterial` survives
the call. A rotated credential reaches the very next signature without a
restart.

Errors are `WalletError` with stable codes: `wallet-not-found`,
`chain-unsupported`, `credential-unconfigured`, `invalid-key-ref`,
`duplicate-adapter`.

Event `wallet/signed` (emit) fires after each completed signing operation with
`{ wallet, chain, operation, address }` — identity facts for audit, never
material.

## Extension points

- Implement `CryptoAdapter` and `ctx.effect(() => ctx.wallet.register(chain,
  adapter))` from a provider plugin. What `WalletKeySource.secret` *means* is
  the adapter's custody model: OWS adapters treat it as the vault passphrase /
  `ows_key_…` token (the private key stays in the OWS vault); a raw-key
  adapter would treat it as key material.
- `wallet/signed` for audit trails.

## Model Experience

None directly: this package registers no tools and contributes no prompt
sections, so it has no model-visible surface, token cost, or KV-cache effect.
A separate tool plugin may expose signing to the model; gate it with policy
(e.g. `dsh-treasury`'s `tools/pre-execute` gate) before doing so.

## Known Limitations and Deferred Work

- No implicit nonce manager: signing calls stay unordered (matching the
  OWS concurrency stance) and callers needing strict transaction ordering
  wrap the whole fetch-nonce → sign → send sequence in `withLock(name,
  task)` — the seam orders, it never assigns nonces itself.
- No model-facing signing tool ships here by design — exposing signatures to
  the model is a deployment decision that belongs with an explicit policy
  gate.
- `address()` establishes a full signing context in adapters whose custody
  model requires authorization even for address derivation; a cheaper
  read-only path is deferred until an adapter needs it.

# dsh-web3

## Quickstart

One-shot get-started (builds latest `02ca906` stack, tests, starts `xmtp-prod`, spits QR + wallet):

```sh
bash quickstart.sh
# or: MUSE_SPARK_API_KEY=<your-key> bash quickstart.sh
```

Spits `Invite URL: https://popup.convos.org/v2?i=...` + ANSI QR (`qrencode -t ANSIUTF8`) and wallet `0xa85dD3FbD8C2c831Ef156036F14638CcFf03b44e` (dynamic `wallet_info`→`ctx.wallet.address`). Also available: `./show-convos-qr.sh` / `./show-xmtp-qr.sh` for QR-only.


Reimplementation of the sovereign web3 agent harness using DeepSeek harness as core, where everything is a plug-in. Replaces https://github.com/Haven-hvn/haven-core and https://github.com/Haven-hvn/haven-adapters

There is deliberately **no aggregate bundle**: people may want one capability
and not another, so each package ships its own `dsh.bundle.patch` →
`cordis.patch.yml` inserting only its own rows, and installs independently:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile <name> add /path/to/dsh-haven/<package>
```

## The packages

| Package | Haven concept | dsh seam it lands on |
| --- | --- | --- |
| [`dsh-wallet`](./dsh-wallet) | `WalletIdentity` custody ("the key never leaves this boundary") + the `CryptoAdapter` contract | `ctx.wallet` service; credentials resolved through `ctx.credentials` per operation — configuration carries *references*, never keys |
| [`dsh-wallet-ethereum`](./dsh-wallet-ethereum) | `EthereumCryptoAdapter` → OWS migration plan | provider plugin registering a `CryptoAdapter` per chain family, backed by `@open-wallet-standard/core` (sign-only; the standard handles all chain families) |
| [`dsh-treasury`](./dsh-treasury) | `Treasury` machine: balances, expenses, FUNDED/LOW/CRITICAL/DEPLETED survival gradient | storage-domain tables + derived state; a policy plugin short-circuits `agent/request` and `tools/pre-execute`, metered off `llm/token-meter` |
| [`dsh-channel-xmtp`](./dsh-channel-xmtp) | `XmtpChannel` direct agent↔user messaging | one dsh agent per conversation (`ctx.agents`), inbound via `agent.followup`, replies via `sendText`; EOA identity signs through `ctx.wallet` |
| [`dsh-storage-synapse`](./dsh-storage-synapse) | `SynapseStorageAdapter` + `StorageBackend` pinning | `ctx.synapse` + `synapse_pin` / `synapse_pin_status` agent tools; every node request wallet-signed per operation |
| [`dsh-wallet-tools`](./dsh-wallet-tools) | wallet address/balance exposure (replaces hard-coded persona) | `wallet_info` tool via `ctx.tools` + `ctx.wallet.address()` live (no hard-coded `0x...`) |
| [`dsh-persona`](./dsh-persona) | Haven persona / system instructions | `agent/request` composition; generic instruction to call `wallet_info` when address/balance/funding asked |
| [`dsh-tool-prowlarr`](./dsh-tool-prowlarr) | Prowlarr indexer search bridge (use-case agnostic) | `prowlarr_indexers` / `prowlarr_search` read-only tools via `ctx.tools`; no wallet seam |
| [`dsh-tool-acquisition`](./dsh-tool-acquisition) | Download/acquisition arm (Haven `acquisition/` port, torrent clients outsourced) | `acquire_submit` / `acquire_status` tools via `ctx.tools`; qBittorrent → Transmission failover, no wallet seam |

## Composition

`dsh-wallet` is the custody root; the other packages build on it:

```
dsh-wallet  ←  dsh-wallet-ethereum   (registers the evm CryptoAdapter)
    ↑
    ├── dsh-channel-xmtp             (signs XMTP identity per signature)
    ├── dsh-storage-synapse          (signs node requests per request)
    └── dsh-wallet-tools             (exposes wallet_info via ctx.tools → ctx.wallet)
dsh-persona                           (composes agent/request; calls wallet_info, no hard-coded address)
dsh-treasury                          (independent; needs the storage stack)
```

A typical full install:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile <name> add \
  /path/to/dsh-haven/dsh-wallet \
  /path/to/dsh-haven/dsh-wallet-ethereum \
  /path/to/dsh-haven/dsh-treasury \
  /path/to/dsh-haven/dsh-channel-xmtp \
  /path/to/dsh-haven/dsh-storage-synapse \
  @open-wallet-standard/core @xmtp/node-sdk
```

The two SDKs are optional peers: every package loads, mounts, and tests
without them (lazy imports with actionable errors; tests substitute
`internals.*` seams).

## Prerequisites

- **Storage stack** (`dsh-treasury` only): the profile must mount `storage`,
  `storage-json`/`storage-sqlite`, and `storage-domain` rows (present in
  `dsh-web-app`; absent in `dsh-base`). The treasury patch does NOT insert
  them — a row id inserted by two layers mounts the plugin twice.
- **Agent stack** (`dsh-channel-xmtp` only): agents/sessions/llm, present in
  any agent-running profile.
- Plugins with unmet `inject` lists stay dormant instead of failing, so
  install order is free.

## Design decision: isolated bundles, coupled seams

Web3 plugins are **isolated as code, coupled at the seam** — a direct consequence of
how the DeepSeek harness composes.

* **Isolated** — every package is a standalone Cordis plugin (`export const name`,
  `export const inject`, `export function apply(ctx, config)`) with its own
  `dsh.bundle.patch` → `cordis.patch.yml`. There is no aggregate bundle; `dsh plugin add`
  installs one capability at a time and `inject` ordering is free (unmet `inject` stays
  dormant). This is why `dsh-wallet`, `dsh-channel-xmtp`, `dsh-storage-synapse`,
  `dsh-treasury`, and `dsh-wallet-tools` each build via `prepare` (tsdown → `lib/`) and test
  without the others (`internals.*` seams).

* **Coupled at the seam** — isolation would break without declared contracts:
  `ctx.wallet` (custody), `ctx.tools` (model-facing tools), `ctx.agents`/`ctx.sessions`
  (per-conversation agents), `ctx.synapse`/`ctx.treasury` (storage). Plugins declare
  this with `inject` — e.g. `inject = ['wallet','tools']` in `dsh-wallet-tools` and
  `dsh-storage-synapse` — so they mount only when the seam exists, and call it
  per-operation (`ctx.wallet.address()`, `ctx.wallet.signMessage()`, `ctx.tools.register(defineTool(...))`).

Harness limitations that force this shape:

1. **Singleton tool runtime.** `@deepseek-ai/dsh-tools` exposes one scheduler (`ctx.tools[TOOL_RUNTIME_SCHEDULER].prepare`). If two instances are deduped incorrectly the `Symbol` mismatches and every `tool/call` fails with `Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'prepare')`. Bundles therefore depend on `dsh-tools` as a **peer** (`0.2.1-alpha.1`, exact — dsh also rejects a bundle whose `@deepseek-ai/dsh-*` peers do not match the running CLI) and `link:` installs must dedupe to one copy.

2. **Wallet custody is per-operation.** Configuration carries only `keyRef`/`wallet` names; `ctx.credentials.resolve` runs inside `signMessage`/`address` and is dropped. Consumers (XMTP identity in `dsh-channel-xmtp`, per-request `x-synapse-*` headers in `dsh-storage-synapse`, `wallet_info` in `dsh-wallet-tools`) see only addresses/signatures. Hard-coding an address in persona (`When asked for address, answer with 0x...`) breaks rotation and wallet-agnostic installs — the correct seam is a tool that resolves `ctx.wallet.address(config.wallet)` live.

3. **Channel is per-conversation, not per-process.** `dsh-channel-xmtp` creates one `ctx.agents` session per XMTP conversation (`SessionId` derived from `conversationId`), handles `conversations.sync()` before `getConversationById`, reconnect/consent sweep, and dedup. The channel owns transport; the agent owns the turn.

Result: add `dsh-wallet` once, then compose any subset. `dsh-wallet-tools` (`wallet_info` tool, `presentCall: {kind:'read'}`) makes the EVM address model-reachable without persona shortcuts; `dsh-channel-xmtp` makes it XMTP-reachable; `dsh-storage-synapse` makes it storage-reachable — all through `ctx.wallet`, none by sharing key material.

2. Secrets exist only **inside one operation**: `ctx.credentials.resolve` runs
   per call, the provider signs, every reference is dropped. Rotation reaches
   the very next operation without restart.
3. Consumers (XMTP signer, Synapse requests, future channels) see only
   **addresses and signatures** through `ctx.wallet`.


path installs work without monorepo context. Money figures are integer µUSD
(USD × 1e6) throughout, matching haven-core.

小狗工作台 · Puppy Workbench

一个 DeepSeek Harness（DSH）插件：把 AI 在你电脑上做的每一步，画成一座像素小岛上的小狗故事。
A DSH plugin that turns every real step your AI agent takes into a little pixel-art island where puppies act it out.

中文 · English

--- ## 中文 ### 这是什么 第一次用 AI Agent 的人常问：「它到底在我电脑上干什么？」日志看不懂，命令看不懂。 小狗工作台把**正在运行的真实会话**画成一座小岛： | 画面里 | 实际上 | |---|---| | 小岛 | 你的电脑 | | 一只小狗 | 一个 AI 会话；领队是你直接对话的 AI，帮手是它派出去的子 Agent | | 海里的鲸鱼 | 大模型。每一步之前小狗都抬头问鲸鱼；鲸鱼冒的泡泡越多，大模型这次真实想得越久 | | 花圃（木牌写文件夹名） | 闻花 = 读文件，种花 = 写文件 | | 风车 | 跑终端命令；失败冒黑烟 | | 岸边工具棚 | 接到 AI 上的本机软件（MCP，模型上下文协议） | | 海那边的浮标和邮船 | 上网取网页 | | 远处的小浮岛和海鸥 | 云端服务 | | 小屋门口 | 你。需要你批准时，小狗抱着花坐在门口举牌「可以吗？」 | | 鲸鱼喷出彩虹 | AI 给了你最终回答 | 小狗的反应跟着真实结果走：读到东西摇尾巴，失败了垂头甩脑袋，帮手交差时和领队碰碰鼻子。闲着的时候会闻闻地、挠耳朵、追蝴蝶——这些只是在玩，图鉴里写明了。

### 特点 - **全是真的**：每个动作都对应会话日志里一条真实记录，点开能看原始内容。唯一的推测是「连线」（东西从哪来、写到哪去），界面上标明了。 - **不会突然冒出来**：花从芽长出来，帮手从一团绒毛里长大，牌子翻面换字。 - **沉浸模式**：点「文字」把所有标注淡出，只留小狗的对话气泡和动画。 - **三维像素画**：Blender 建模、three.js 实时渲染，再画成像素画。不支持 WebGL 时退回平面版。 - **照顾「减少动态效果」**：系统开启时只用约 0.15 秒的淡入淡出。 ### 安装 需要 DeepSeek Harness 桌面版。 **方法一：本地文件夹（已验证）** 1. 下载本仓库（Code → Download ZIP，或 Releases 里的 ZIP）并解压。 2. DSH →「插件」→「添加插件」，填入解压后文件夹的完整路径。 3. 重启 Harness，刷新界面。 **方法二：插件市场索引源** DSH →「插件」→「发现」→「索引源」，添加： ``` https://raw.githubusercontent.com/hgognav233-netizen/dsh-puppy-workflow/main/index.json ``` 然后在「发现」里搜「小狗工作台」安装。 装好后：对话输入框旁有「小狗」按钮（看当前会话），左栏有「小狗工作台」（看最近的会话）。 ### 隐私 - 只**读**本机的会话日志：不写会话、不上传、不访问外网。 - three.js 和小岛模型都从插件自己的本地地址加载。 - 面板里会显示文件夹名、命令摘要、消息片段——截图分享前留意。 ### 局限 - 本机软件和云端服务是按 MCP 服务器名字猜的，猜不中的云服务会画成岸边工具棚。 - 篮子里的枝叶是读进来的份数，不是真实的 token 用量（日志里没有这个数）。 - 花圃最多同时 4 块、工具棚 1 个、浮标 4 个，按最近使用轮换。 - 第一次打开要加载约 1.7 MB。 --- ## English ### What it is People new to AI agents keep asking: *what is it actually doing on my computer?* Logs and shell commands don't help. Puppy Workbench draws the **live session** as an island: | On screen | What it means | |---|---| | The island | Your computer | | A puppy | An agent session — the lead is the AI you talk to, helpers are the sub-agents it sends out | | The whale | The model. Before every step the puppy looks up and asks the whale; more bubbles = the model really took longer to think | | Flower beds (signposts name the folders) | Sniffing = reading a file, planting = writing one | | The windmill | Running a shell command; black smoke on failure | | Shed on the shore | A local app plugged into the AI (MCP, the Model Context Protocol) | | Buoys and the mail boat | Fetching web pages | | The little islet and its gulls | Cloud services | | The cottage door | You. When the AI needs your approval, a puppy sits at the door holding a flower and a sign: "May I?" | | A rainbow from the whale | The AI gave you its final answer | Reactions follow real results: a wag for a successful read, a hung head and a shake for a failure, a nose-boop when a helper hands its work back. Idle puppies sniff, scratch and chase butterflies — that's just play, and the picture guide says so.

### Highlights - **Everything is real.** Each animation is one record in the session log; click it to see the raw entry. The only guess — the "flow" lines showing where things came from and went — is labelled as a guess. - **Nothing pops.** Flowers grow from sprouts, helpers grow out of a puff of fluff, signs flip to change their words. - **Immersive mode.** Toggle "Words" off to fade every label, leaving only the puppies' speech bubbles and the animation. - **3D pixel art.** Modelled in Blender, rendered live with three.js, drawn as pixel art. Falls back to a flat 2D island without WebGL. - **Respects reduced motion.** Only ~150 ms fades when the OS asks for less motion. ### Install Requires the DeepSeek Harness desktop app. **Option 1 — local folder (verified)** 1. Download this repository (Code → Download ZIP, or the ZIP under Releases) and unzip it. 2. DSH → Plugins → Add plugin, and enter the full path of the unzipped folder. 3. Restart the Harness and reload the window. **Option 2 — market index source** DSH → Plugins → Discover → Index sources, add: ``` https://raw.githubusercontent.com/hgognav233-netizen/dsh-puppy-workflow/main/index.json ``` then search for "Puppy workbench" in Discover. Once installed: a "Puppy" button sits next to the chat input (current session), and "Puppy workbench" appears in the left sidebar (recent sessions). ### Privacy - It only **reads** the local session logs: it writes nothing, uploads nothing, and makes no network requests. - three.js and the island model load from the plugin's own local route. - The panel shows folder names, command summaries and message snippets — mind that before sharing screenshots. ### Limits - Local vs cloud MCP servers are guessed from the server name; unrecognised cloud services are drawn as a shed on the shore. - The twigs in the basket count files read in, not real token usage (the log doesn't record that). - At most 4 flower beds, 1 shed and 4 buoys at once, rotated by recent use. - First open loads about 1.7 MB. --- ## Credits · 致谢 - [three.js](https://threejs.org) 0.184.0, MIT — `vendor/three/`, unmodified; source and checksums in `vendor/README.md`. - Island modelled in Blender for this project. ## License MIT — see [LICENSE](LICENSE).

Native host reads session logs and client renders a local 3D activity view. Literal-import scanner matches embedded rewritten browser module strings; these are not asserted to be missing runtime imports. Screenshots may expose local paths and conversation excerpts. No candidate code or lifecycle hooks were executed; runtime safety and compatibility are unproven.

[README.md](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/35456313/README.md)

# Token budget guard

English | [中文](README.zh.md)

A DeepSeek Harness plugin that watches the cost of **a single model reply**: when one reply used more tokens than your threshold, the next tool call pauses and asks you whether to continue or stop.

## How it decides

1. Before every tool call, the plugin reads the **most recent** `assistant/message` event from the session log.
2. Usage = `totalTokens`; when that is missing it sums `input + output + cacheRead + cacheWrite`.
3. Above `threshold` → one question with two options:
   - **Continue**: this tool call runs as usual.
   - **Stop here**: the tool call is denied, and the agent is told to stop and give a short progress summary.

The same model call is asked about only once (deduplicated by session id and event sequence).

## Configuration

Edit `cordis.patch.yml` in this directory, or override the row by id in your profile's `cordis.patch.yml`:

```yaml
- id: budget-guard
  name: '@local/budget-guard'
  config:
    threshold: 30000
```

| You want | Set |
|---|---|
| 20k | `20000` |
| 100k | `100000` |
| 500k | `500000` |

`threshold` is in tokens and defaults to `100000`. An override replaces the whole `config` of the row, so repeat `unitNote` if you rely on it.

## Install

Requires a profile that mounts `userQuestions` (the standard preset ships with it).

1. Clone this repository.
2. Install the `dsh-budget-guard` folder as a local bundle in DSH's plugin manager, then enable it.
3. Restart DSH: the plugin loads at startup and code changes need a restart.

## Limitations

- Numbers come from provider-reported usage; when `totalTokens` is absent the sum can undercount cached tokens.
- It only triggers when a tool call follows. A long text-only reply is never interrupted midway.
- Without `userQuestions` the question cannot be shown, and the guard lets work continue.
- The question text and the two option labels are currently written in Chinese only.

decision.reason: Held for versioned DSH compatibility. MIT and clone/local-bundle installation are documented. A native tools/pre-execute hook reads latest assistant usage and asks userQuestions to continue or deny. No versioned DSH declaration was captured. No candidate code or lifecycle hooks were executed; runtime safety and compatibility are unproven.

evidence.readmeExcerpt:
# 藏海 · canghai

> 二次元知识图鉴引擎 + 控制面板。可接入 **QQAgent** 与 **DSH** 两个宿主，支持可插拔外部数据源，本地秒查、离线可用、定时保鲜。

藏海（canghai）是一份「知识图鉴」：把动漫 / 游戏 / 影视的名场面、角色设定、网络新梗收进本地，让聊天机器人**不联网也能秒查**「这是什么 / 他是谁」。它与记忆系统职责正交——**藏海答「是什么」，记忆答「聊过没有」**。

```
        外部数据源（GitHub 上的百科数据集）
                    │  定时 / 手动同步
                    ▼
        ┌───────────────────────┐
        │   藏海核心 (core)      │  ← 宿主无关，可 CLI 独立运行
        │  schema · search ·    │
        │  kb-store · sync      │
        └──────────┬────────────┘
          ┌────────┴────────┐
          ▼                 ▼
    QQAgent 适配器      DSH 适配器        ← 只负责「接线」，逻辑共用
   (setup(api))      (Cordis apply)
          │                 │
          ▼                 ▼
      查词工具 + 控制面板（二次元 UI，http://127.0.0.1:8792）
```

---

## 库内有什么（2429 条，随仓库发布）

clone 下来**即有数据**，无需先联网同步：

| 库 | 条数 | 内容 |
|---|---|---|
| `chime` | 1313 | CHIME 中文网络梗数据集（EMNLP 2025，MIT） |
| `anime-season` | 602 | 近三年新番表（中日英标题/开播/状态） |
| `genshin-roster` | 124 | 原神全角色（称号/元素/武器/命座/生日） |
| `fandom-game` | 75 | 游戏名场面与术语（MOBA/抽卡/魂系…） |
| `fandom-anime` | 73 | 动漫名场面（鬼灭/咒术/JOJO/宫崎骏…） |
| `game-hits` | 76 | 热门游戏角色机制（LOL/王者/CS/吃鸡/黑神话…） |
| `fandom-film` | 67 | 影视名场面（星战/漫威/让子弹飞/狂飙…） |
| `characters-core` | 38 | 核心角色人设（性格/外貌/背景） |
| `warhammer` | 27 | 战锤 40K 军团与势力（18 军团 + 8 势力） |
| `game-mihoyo` | 19 | 星穹铁道 + 崩坏3 角色 |
| `game-arknights` | 11 | 明日方舟角色与机制 |
| `seed` / `memes` | 2 + 38 | 人工种子与网络流行语 |

分布：**动漫约 700 + 游戏约 500 + 影视约 70 + 网络梗 1300+**。`data/seed/` 是人工精选（可自由编辑），`data/kb/` 是同步快照（`npm run sync` 刷新）。

---

## 1. 为什么它不与记忆系统冲突

这是设计前提，不是事后补丁。两个系统**数据、意图、时机都不同**：

| | 记忆系统（conversation-memory） | 藏海（canghai） |
|---|---|---|
| 存什么 | 发生过的对话、印象、事实 | 百科定义、梗、角色设定 |
| 回答 | 「我们上次聊过尼尔吗」「他说过什么」 | 「尼尔是什么」「钟离是谁」 |
| 算法 | 倒排索引 + TF-IDF/BM25 打分 | title 精确匹配 + 别名 + 子串打分 |
| 数据目录 | `memory-v2/` | `canghai/kb/`（**绝不交叉**） |

**硬边界（代码保证）**：
- 藏海只读写自己 `dataDir/kb/`，不 import、不触碰 `memory-v2/`。
- 两个工具各自注册，**描述里写死触发词**：藏海「是什么/是谁」，记忆「上次/之前/说过」。
- 若要将「藏海新收录的角色」写进记忆，那属于**写入**，走记忆的 `archive` 能力，不经藏海检索层。

---

## 2. 目录结构

```
canghai/
├─ index.js                  # 主入口 createEngine()（宿主/CLI 共用）
├─ cli.js                    # 独立 CLI：sync / search / stats
├─ server.js                 # 本地控制面板服务（默认 :8792）
├─ sources.config.json       # ★ 数据源声明式配置
├─ core/
│  ├─ schema.js              # ★ 数据格式约定 + 校验（数据契约）
│  ├─ search.js              # 检索引擎（精确优先）
│  ├─ kb-store.js            # 读 kb/*.json、按优先级去重、原子写
│  ├─ sync.js                # ★ 同步编排（不认识具体源）
│  ├─ errors.js              # ★ 异常分类 + 降级策略
│  └─ sources/               # ★ 可插拔数据源
│     ├─ contract.js         #   适配器接口约定
│     ├─ registry.js         #   按 config 动态加载适配器
│     ├─ local-file.js       #   本地 JSON（种子/兜底）
│     ├─ genshin-db.js       #   原神全角色
│     └─ anime-data.js       #   新番季度表
├─ adapters/
│  ├─ qqagent/               # QQAgent 版（skill.json + index.js, setup(api)）
│  └─ dsh/                   # DSH 版（Cordis apply(ctx)）
├─ panel/                    # 二次元控制面板（index.html + theme.css + app.js）
└─ data/
   ├─ seed/                  # 人工种子库（优先级最高）
   └─ kb/                    # 运行库（同步产物 + 种子落库）
```

---

## 3. 快速开始（不依赖任何宿主）

```bash
git clone <this-repo> canghai && cd canghai
node cli.js sync          # 从数据源拉取，写入 data/kb/
node cli.js search 钟离    # 本地秒查
node cli.js stats         # 看库统计
node server.js            # 起控制面板 → http://127.0.0.1:8792
```

零依赖，Node ≥ 20。首次 `sync` 需要联网（从 GitHub 拉数据）；之后检索**完全离线**。

---

## 4. 与两个宿主的对接

### 4.1 QQAgent 版

1. 把整个 `canghai/` 拷到 QQAgent 的 `plugins/canghai/`（`adapters/qqagent/` 里的 `skill.json` + `index.js` 即插件入口）。
2. 重启 / 热重载。插件注册工具 `canghai__lookup`，模型即可在聊天中查询。
3. 设置项（`skill.json.settings`）：`dataDir`、`lookupLimit`、`panelPort`、`autoSync`。
4. 面板：`node plugins/canghai/server.js`，或由宿主开内嵌窗口加载 `http://127.0.0.1:8792`。

**对接点**：`setup(api)` → `api.registerTool({id:'lookup', ...})`；可选 `api.registerCapability('knowledge.canghai')` 供其它插件软依赖。

### 4.2 DSH 版（可一键安装）

本仓库根 `package.json` 本身就是 DSH 插件包（`main` → `adapters/dsh/index.js`，`dsh.bundle.patch` → `cordis.patch.yml`），所以**整仓即可作为插件安装**：

```bash
# 桌面版
dsh plugin --profile desktop add github:Ice-Bearmax/canghai
# Web 版
dsh plugin --profile web add github:Ice-Bearmax/canghai
```

装完重启 DSH。插件会自动：

1. 首次启动若本地库为空 → **从包内 `data/seed` 灌入种子**（不联网、毫秒级，装完即可查）；
2. 随后后台跑一次全量同步（联网，失败不影响已可用的种子库）。

注册工具：`canghai_lookup`（查词）、`canghai_sync`（手动更新）。

环境变量：`CANGHAI_DATA_DIR`（数据目录）、`CANGHAI_LOOKUP_LIMIT`（返回条数）、`CANGHAI_NO_BG_SYNC=1`（关闭后台同步，纯离线）。

**与 QQ 机器人联动**：配合 [`dsh-qq-bot`](https://github.com/arrow1031-dev/dsh-qq-bot)（每个 QQ 会话一个 DSH Agent），藏海的 `canghai_lookup` 与它注册的工具同在一张全局工具表，群友提问时 agent 可直接调用，**无需改一行代码**。注意：QQ 访客若受工具白名单限制，需在 `dsh-qq-bot` 侧放行该工具；且同一 QQ 号不要同时连两个机器人（详见该插件 README）。

> 两版**共用同一个 `core/`**，只是接线方式不同。这就是「做两版」而不用维护两套逻辑。

---

## 5. 控制面板（二次元 UI）

统一设计系统（`panel/theme.css`）：深海配色（鲸蓝 `#4ea8de` / 柔光青 `#7fe3d4` / 浪花白）+ 圆润卡片 + 呼吸动效 + 楷体标题。改主题只改这一个文件。

| 页面 | 功能 | 主要操作路径 |
|---|---|---|
| **概览** | 四个统计卡（条目/文件/来源/自学习）、**领域覆盖条形图**（标出最缺领域）、来源分布、热门标签 | 打开即看 |
| **检索** | 关键词 + **领域筛选** + 返回条数，结果含释义/别名/出处/来源/匹配度 | 输入 → 回车 |
| **条目管理** | 分页浏览（可调 20/50/100），按领域/来源/关键词筛选；**新增/编辑/删除** | 筛选 → 行内「改/删」或「+ 新增」 |
| **数据源** | 每个源的**开关**（写 `sources.local.json`）、条数、适配器、**单独同步**；附新增源三步说明 | 拨开关 / 点单独同步 |
| **同步** | 全部或单源同步，逐源显示 条数/耗时/是否变化/错误 | 点「同步全部」 |
| **关于/设置** | 运行时（最近更新时间、加载报告）、schema 字段约定、**本地 API 一览** | 打开即看 |

可写操作只影响**自学习库**（`data/user/`）：人工精选（`data/seed/`）与同步产物（`data/kb/`）在界面上是只读的（🔒），避免误删源数据。

API（`server.js`）：

| 方法 | 路径 | 作用 |
|---|---|---|
| GET | `/api/stats` | 总量/领域/来源/自学习数/最缺领域 |
| GET | `/api/search?q=&domain=&limit=` | 检索（可筛领域） |
| GET | `/api/entries?page=&size=&domain=&source=&q=` | 分页浏览 |
| POST | `/api/entries` | 新增/更新条目（写自学习库，同名覆盖） |
| DELETE | `/api/entries?title=` | 删除自学习条目（他人条目拒绝） |
| POST | `/api/sources` `{id, enabled}` | 开关数据源（写 `sources.local.json`） |
| POST | `/api/sync` `{only?}` | 同步（全部或指定源） |
| GET | `/api/config` / `/api/schema` | 数据源配置 / 字段约定 |

---

## 6. 数据格式约定（schema）

任何数据源归一化后都必须产出符合以下契约的 `entry`（`core/schema.js`）：

| 字段 | 类型 | 必填 | 说明 |
|---|---|---|---|
| `title` | string | ✅ | 图鉴项名字，检索主键 |
| `aliases` | string[] | | 别名/其他写法（命中权重仅次于 title） |
| `meaning` | string | | 是什么/什么意思 |
| `usage` | string | | 怎么用/例句 |
| `tone` | string | | 语气 |
| `era` | string | | 出处（作品/游戏） |
| `freshness` | enum | | `常用` / `偏旧` / `正热` |
| `tags` | string[] | | 分类标签 |

系统保留字段（数据源不得提供，会被丢弃）：`_source`、`_syncedAt`、`_generated`、`_target`。

`validateMany()` 会逐条校验：**坏的跳过并记录原因，好的留下**，产出同步报告。

---

## 7. 数据源接入与扩展（核心卖点）

### 7.1 配置项（`sources.config.json`）

```jsonc
{
  "version": 1,
  "sources": [
    {
      "id": "genshin",             // 唯一 id（也是落库文件名前缀）
      "adapter": "genshin-db",     // 对应 core/sources/genshin-db.js
      "enabled": true,             // false = 跳过
      "target": "genshin-roster.json",  // 写入 data/kb/ 的文件名
      "config": {                  // 覆盖适配器 configSpec 的默认值
        "maxCharacters": 0,
        "skipPlaceholder": true
      }
    }
  ]
}
```

`enabled:false` 即停用；`sources.local.json` 可覆盖同名项（本地实验不污染仓库）。

### 7.2 加一个数据源 = 3 步，**不改核心**

1. 在 `core/sources/` 新建 `my-source.js`，实现约定（见 `contract.js`）：

   ```js
   export default {
     id: 'my-source',
     label: '我的数据源',
     configSpec: { url: { type:'string', default:'', label:'地址' } },
     targetFile: 'my-source.json',
     async fetch(ctx) { /* 拉数据，失败 throw sourceError(ERR.*, ...) */ },
     normalize(raw) { /* → 符合 schema 的 entry[] */ }
   };
   ```

2. 在 `sources.config.json` 的 `sources[]` 加一项（`adapter: 'my-source'`）。
3. 跑 `node cli.js sync --only=my-source`。

`registry.js` 自动发现文件，`sync.js` 只认接口不认具体源 —— **新增/切换/停用数据源，核心逻辑一行不改**。

### 7.3 数据源接入的异常处理（`core/errors.js`）

| 错误码 | 场景 | 策略 |
|---|---|---|
| `NETWORK` | 超时/连不上 | **可重试**（退避重试） |
| `HTTP` 429/5xx | 限流/上游故障 | 可轻量重试，读 `Retry-After` |
| `HTTP` 401/403 | 鉴权/风控 | 不重试，跳过并报 `AUTH` |
| `PARSE` | 非 JSON/结构变了 | 不重试，多半上游改版 |
| `EMPTY` | 源正常但 0 条 | **不清空旧库**（除非确认真空） |
| `SCHEMA` | 条目不合约定 | 部分入库，其余记 rejected |

**铁律**：任何源失败都**保留旧库**，绝不让一次网络抖动把本地几千条清空。同步产出结构化报告（每源 ok/条数/耗时/错误），面板与 CLI 共用。

### 7.4 当前内置数据源

| 适配器 | 内容 | 上游更新 |
|---|---|---|
| `genshin-db` | 原神全角色（124+，含称号/元素/武器/命座/生日） | 随游戏版本 |
| `anime-data` | 新番季度表（中日英标题/开播/状态/Bangumi ID） | 每週一自动 |
| `local-file` | 本地 JSON 种子/兜底 | 手动 |

---

## 8. 许可

MIT。数据来源遵循各自许可（genshin-db / anime-data 均为公开解析数据）。

evidence.readmeExcerpt:
# dsh-ivory-shell

> **Status:** `0.0.1` (M0 Dual-Face Skeleton — part of **[The Ivory Tower](https://github.com/janpauldahlke/the-ivory-tower)** Studio suite for [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness))

Studio shell & profile bundle for DeepSeek Harness: strips developer/shell chrome and mounts a calm co-authoring Start Desk via typed UI slots.

## Bounded Context (*Fachlichkeit*)

Occupies sidebar.brand.* and conversation.hero.* UI slots, enables session-query-sqlite on first search, and disables bash/fs/terminal UI rows cleanly via dsh.bundle.patch without forking dsh core.

- **English-first, domain-neutral core:** All tool schemas, error codes, and UI chrome stay domain-neutral and provider-agnostic (`llama.cpp` local *and* OpenRouter / cloud).
- **Dual-face packaging:** Built with [`dsh-build-tools`](https://github.com/janpauldahlke/dsh-build-tools) (`lib/index.js` ESM host + `lib/client.js` CJS `__ModuleLoader__` client + `lib/core.mjs` hermetic core for `node --test`).

## Development

```sh
npm install
npm run build   # node build.mjs && tsc --noEmit
npm test        # node build.mjs && node --test "test/**/*.test.mjs"
```

## License

MIT — see [`LICENSE`](./LICENSE).

# @local/dsh-lazy-plugins

按需加载市场插件的 Host 插件（v3.14.4）。本地没有的插件，在任务需要时由 agent 从市场索引解析、安装、**当场可用**；用完可以卸载移除。
默认激活方式为 `proxy`：插件真正生效，但它的工具**不进模型可见的 tools[]**，因此不会打碎提示词前缀缓存。

## Claude 式形态（v3.14）

常驻只注入一句（152 字符 / ≈38 tokens），细节在注册的 **skill** 正文里，模型需要时才加载：

- `skills/lazy-plugins/SKILL.md`：frontmatter（name/description/whenToUse）+ 正文（何时用、三个动作、判定规则、示例、注意）；
- 插件 apply 时读文件并 `ctx.get("skills").register({ name, description, whenToUse, content, invocation, provider, source: "runtime" })`；
- 实测：工具描述 **936 → 152 字符（234 → 38 tokens）**，skill 出现在模型技能目录并能按需加载（`advise.skill = ["lazy-plugins:runtime"]`）。

## 工具（模型可见面）

只有一个工具 `lazy_plugin`：

| 动作 | 含义 |
|---|---|
| `ensure` | **给一句需求**，自动挑出最匹配的插件并在判定明确时直接安装（默认走 proxy） |
| `suggest` | 任务句 → 候选排序（IDF 加权，可翻页） |
| `search` | 关键词检索（可翻页，去重 + 隐藏装不上的条目） |
| `resolve` | 看一个包的版本、安装目标（npm / git）、兼容性 |
| `load` | 安装指定版本并激活（已装则只做启用） |
| `reload` | 停用→启用，让新版本模块生效（不重启 dsh） |
| `unload` | 停用但保留安装 |
| `release` | 停用并移除 |
| `uninstall` | 直接移除 |
| `list` | 已装清单、懒加载记录、常驻判定与使用分、索引缓存状态 |
| `refresh` | 立刻刷新索引（条件请求）并预热常驻插件 |
| `advise` | 体检：工具面 tokens、缓存命中率、使用分、隐藏工具、建议 |
| `invoke` | 调用被 proxy 隐藏的工具（`{tool, arguments}`） |

## 模型调用准则

1. **有需求先 `ensure`**：一句话描述要做什么，它负责挑；判定不明确时才回候选让人选。
2. 想自己挑就用 `suggest` / `search`，按「描述最匹配」优先，其次热度；可 `offset` 翻页。
3. **优先最新版本**：不传 `version` 就是索引默认（最新）版本。
4. **一次装一个**，用完 `release`，不要囤。
5. `load` 回 `installable:false` 说明该条目任何 registry 都装不上（索引里有这类幽灵条目），换候选，别重试同一个。
6. 没有 `force` 参数：base bundle 一律拒绝停用/移除，常用插件只提示不阻断。

## 激活方式与提示词缓存

工具是 API 独立字段 `tools[]`、按名字排序，缓存断点在最后一个工具，所以**可见工具集一变，前缀就重建**。

| `activate` | 当场能用 | 前缀缓存 | 做法 |
|---|---|---|---|
| `proxy`（默认） | ✅ | ✅ 不变 | 插件激活，工具被 **per-agent `tools.restrict`** 藏起来，经 `invoke` 调用 |
| `now` | ✅ | ❌ 重建一次 | 工具原生进入 `tools[]` |
| `session` | ❌ | ✅ | 只安装，之后 `load` 一次启用（无下载，约 0.1–0.5 s） |

`invoke` 之所以能调用隐藏工具：`tools.execute()` 在 host 作用域执行，而 `restrict` 只作用于 agent 作用域（实测：`visibleForAgent: false` / `visibleGlobally: true` / `executeWithoutAgent: ok`）。
屏蔽落盘在 `hidden.json`，启动时重新打上；插件卸载后失效名字会自动剔除；插件异步注册的工具由 1.2 s / 3.5 s / 7 s 三次补扫兜住。

## 检索与自动选取

- **候选池**：`limit × 3`，先按相关性排序，再 `enrich`、过滤不可装、按安装目标合并近重复（`dsh-voice-7` / `dsh-voice-13` → `dsh-voice`，带 `variants`）。
- **IDF 加权**：`idf = ln(1 + N/(1+df))`，命中按 `idf × 字段权重`（name 3 / title 2 / description 2）累加，`dsh`/`plugin` 这类全库词不再决定排序。
- **自动选取守卫**：`ensure` 只在 `top ≥ autoSelectScore(40)` **且** `top ≥ 第二名 × autoSelectMargin(1.5)` 时才装，否则回 `needs-choice` + 候选；`auto:false` 只报告不装。
- **阈值是实测校准出来的**（31 条真实需求语料）：`40/1.3` 的自动安装精度只有 **0.636**（11 次装错 4 次），`40/1.5` 提升到 **0.80**（recall 0.367→0.167）；没有参数组合能到 0.90，所以默认偏保守，模型多看候选是更便宜的错误。
- **git-pinned 条目**（当前占 52.5%）判为可装、不走 npm 探测；`source` 字段直接回 `npm` / `git`。

## 常驻（resident）怎么算

三路来源（社区做法见 CREDITS.md）：

| 来源 | 判定 | 效果 |
|---|---|---|
| `base` | `availability !== 'profile'` 且**当前启用**的 bundle | 硬拒绝 `unload/release/uninstall` |
| `explicit` | `config.resident` | 只加提示，不阻断 |
| `auto` | `score >= residentScore(3)` | 只加提示，不阻断 |

```
score = 1.0·Σ_loads + 0.3·Σ_manualEnables + (base ? 1000 : 0)   每项 × 0.5^(Δ/14天)
```

只写本机 `~/.dsh/cache/dsh-lazy-plugins/usage.json`，不联网、不上报。

## 索引与缓存

- **拉取**：单次尝试只等首字节 3 s，失败转镜像；源顺序 = profile 索引 → `indexMirrors`。
- **缓存优先**：磁盘副本直接返回，后台条件请求热更新（304 = 0 字节）；断网时旧副本仍可用。
- **描述表**：索引自身描述覆盖率 ≥80% 时**直接投影**（零额外请求）；否则按 `descriptionSources` 拉 sidecar/旧文档。
- **刷新触发**：启动一次、**打开插件面板一次**（client 半调用 `GET /lazy-plugins/refresh?src=panel`，60 s 节流）、每天保底一次、手动 `refresh`。
- **client 半**：`client.js` + `package.json` 的 `dsh.client{platform:web,immediately:true}` + `exports['./client']`，用 `window.__ModuleLoader__.load({id, factory})` 形态（无需构建）。页面挂载即调 `GET /lazy-plugins/refresh?src=mount`，点进插件面板再调 `?src=panel`，页面侧 60 s 节流 + `sessionStorage`，失败只 `console.debug`。
- **自愈（重要，给后续维护者）**：`link:` 安装的包在**主机进程启动早于 `dsh.client` 声明**时，会被上游 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-modules` 的 `ClientModuleRegistry.pkgMeta` 缓存成 `null`（该缓存**没有任何失效路径**，`set_bundle false/true` 命中缓存、不够）。本插件在**启动后 `bootDelayMs` 自动一次**、以及显式 `POST /lazy-plugins/repair-client`（或 `GET /lazy-plugins/state?repair=1`）时自愈：删掉陈旧 `null` → 强制 `reconcile` 报变更 → `flush()`（内部 `compose()` + 通知）→ 图里出现本行。`GET /lazy-plugins/state` 本身**纯读、无副作用**。
- **自愈返回值**：`repair.attempted:false` + `why:"already in graph"` 是**幂等 no-op（已在图中，不是失败）**；真正的失败看 `repair.errors` 或 `repair.compose.error/failures`。
- **自愈的退出条件（必须遵守）**：这是**上游缺陷的 workaround**，不是本插件的功能。一旦 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-modules` 让 `pkgMeta` 的 key 带上 `package.json` 的 mtime/size、或暴露 `invalidate()`、或 `flush()` 前对 dirty 行强制重解析 —— 就**整段删除** `ensureClientRow` 及其三个触发点（启动定时器、`POST /lazy-plugins/repair-client`、`GET /state?repair=1`），此 README 对应段落一并删除。依据与建议修法见 `_tmp/panel-trigger/UPSTREAM-ISSUE.md`；`clientHalf.lastRepair.upstream` 字段也带同一句提示。
- **验证计数**：`state.panelPings`（过闸执行的刷新数）、`clientRequests`（含被节流的客户端调用）、`browserPings`（带 `Sec-Fetch-Mode`+浏览器 UA 的调用，`curl` 伪造不了）+ `lastBrowserPingFingerprint`、`lastBrowserPingSource`（`mount`/`panel`），以及 `clientHalf{inGraph,rows,graphRev,url,clientPath,lastRepair}`。
- 索引现状（2026-11-07 实测）：10,559 条、99.96% 带 zh 描述、52.5% git-pinned、166 个后缀名条目。

## 装前探测与别名

- npm 条目：并行 HEAD `<registry>/<name>/<version>`（命中 26–230 ms）；全 404 直接回 `installable:false`；超时/网络错判为未知，不挡安装。
- 别名：索引把重名条目改名成 `dsh-voice-8`，真实包名在 `title`。`load` 用 `title` 作第二候选，探测通过就装真名并回 `installedAs`。

## 可配置项

`cordis.patch.yml`（全部有默认值）：`defaultActivate`、`autoSelectScore`、`autoSelectMargin`、`autoSelectEnabled`、`resident`、`halfLifeDays`、`residentScore`、`fetchTimeoutMs`、`bodyTimeoutMs`、`refreshIntervalMs`、`dailyRefreshMs`、`panelThrottleMs`、`bootDelayMs`、`indexMirrors`、`descriptionSources`、`descriptionTtlMs`、`descriptionSearch`、`enrichDescriptions`、`enrichTimeoutMs`、`enrichRegistries`、`verifyInstall`、`probeFastMs`、`probeTimeoutMs`、`deferLoading`、`diskCache`、`cacheTtlMs`。

## 性能（本机实测）

| 场景 | 耗时 |
|---|---|
| 已装再 `load`（快路径） | 75–490 ms |
| 冷装小包（含探测+安装+激活） | 1.9–2.6 s |
| 冷装大包 / registry 抖动 | 3–5 s（个别 38 s，属上游 installBundle 抖动） |
| git-pinned 安装（`@lbxc/dsh-voice-input`） | 5.07 s |
| 索引冷拉 | ~1.0–1.7 s（gzip 约 300 KB–1 MB，随版本变化） |
| 索引 304 热更新 | 0.5–1.1 s / 0 字节 |
| 索引磁盘命中（新进程） | 42 ms |
| `search` / `suggest`（本地 10,559 条，含 IDF 扫描） | 10–30 ms |

`load` 结果带 `phases`（lookup/resolve/probe/install）与 `ms`；`advise.cache` 有命中率计数。

## 失败恢复

`reload` 是「先停用再启用」，启用失败会停在停用态 → 现在失败自动重试一次并回传 `diagnostic` + 修复提示（最常见成因：`cordis.patch.yml` 里 `@scope` 未加引号）。

## 数据边界

只做三件事：读市场索引、调 profile 的 `pluginManager`、返回结果。不写日志文件、不上报、不采集会话内容。

## 出处

见 `CREDITS.md`。

# dsh-market · DSH 插件市场索引（自动爬取）

为 DeepSeek Harness（DSH）的「插件 → 发现」提供一份**自动生成、格式合规**的索引源。

- 主源（GitHub Pages，实测最稳）：`https://jingjiangze.github.io/dsh-market/index.json`
- 品牌域名（Cloudflare Pages）：`https://dsh.jiangjiangze.icu/index.json`
- 两个地址内容同源：都来自本仓库 `site/`，由 CI 生成后提交

## 加进 DSH

「插件 → 发现 → 添加索引源」，两个都加（互为主备）：

```
https://jingjiangze.github.io/dsh-market/index.json
https://dsh.jiangjiangze.icu/index.json
```

> 为什么主源选 GitHub Pages：2026-11-02 本机直连实测 **3/3 成功，0.61–0.81 s**；同一份索引走 Cloudflare Pages 自定义域名时 **3 次里 1 次卡在 25 s 只收到 538 B**、其余 3.8–17.5 s（CF 边缘境内无节点，直连不稳；走代理 2/2 成功 1.9–2.9 s）。DSH 的 fetch 超时是 15 s，所以把 Pages 当人读站点、把 GitHub Pages 当机器源，两边都不丢。

## 它是什么 / 不是什么

- 是：从 **npm 公共源**爬到的、**声明了 `dsh.bundle.patch`** 且 `engines.dsh` 满足当前运行时的包的元数据清单（分类、多语言描述、图标直链、精确版本）。
- 不是：不是代码托管，不镜像任何包，不对任何插件背书。装什么、跑什么，以包本身为准。
- 索引里**只有元数据**：`source.type = npm`，安装走你本机 pnpm + 你自己的 registry 配置。

## 爬取与准入（`crawler/crawl.mjs`，零依赖）

```
node crawler/crawl.mjs --selftest     # 门禁自测（正例 + 反例）
node crawler/crawl.mjs                # 爬取并生成 dist/
```

两段式，先便宜后贵：

1. **发现**：`registry.npmjs.org` 关键词检索（`keywords:dsh-plugin`、`keywords:deepseek-harness`、`keywords:dsh`）。
2. **初筛**（每包 1 次 `/<name>/latest`）：必须声明 `dsh.bundle.patch`；不得含 `preinstall`/`install`/`postinstall`。
3. **定版**（入选包再取完整 packument）：取**最新稳定版**且满足 `engines.dsh`；未声明 `engines.dsh` 的一律**不收**（不猜"应该能跑"）；发布不足 `MIN_AGE_DAYS`（默认 3 天）的不收（pnpm 的 `minimumReleaseAge` 会扣住它们，写进索引用户也装不上）；许可为空或 `NOASSERTION`/`UNLICENSED` 的不收。

产出：

| 文件 | 内容 |
|---|---|
| `dist/index.json` | format 1 索引（DSH 唯一读的东西） |
| `dist/index.sidecar.json` | format 1 装不下的东西：`dist.integrity`、provenance、体积、生效的门禁 |
| `dist/rejections.json` | 每个被排除的包 + 原因（可复盘，不静默丢） |
| `dist/stats.json` | 候选数 / 初筛数 / 收录数 / 拒绝原因分布 / 索引字节数 / 耗时 |

环境变量：`NPM_REGISTRY`、`SEARCH_REGISTRY`、`DSH_RUNTIME_VERSION`、`MIN_AGE_DAYS`、`MAX_PLUGINS`、`MAX_CANDIDATES`、`CONCURRENCY`、`SEARCH_QUERIES`。

### 已知的爬取坑（踩过）

- **npmmirror 不支持 `keywords:` 语法**：`registry.npmmirror.com/-/v1/search?text=keywords:dsh-plugin` 返回 `total=0`，而 npmjs 返回约 11.9k。所以**发现阶段固定用 npmjs**；manifest 阶段可换镜像加速。
- **不能信 latest**：一个包可能同时有多个兼容版本，`latest` 未必兼容当前运行时，所以定版要读完整 packument。
- **未声明 `engines.dsh` ≠ 兼容**：DSH 的安装侧会用真实包的 `engines` + `peerDependencies` 再判一次，索引里谎报兼容比不收更伤口碑。

## 站点（`site/`）

- 首页第一屏是**索引源卡片**（渐变描边 + 外发光，纯 CSS）：「由 DSH 制作」徽章、**全部 / 国内 / 国际**三个索引源切换、源地址 + 一键复制。
- `index.html` 690 B；`style.css` / `app.js` 为**同源**资源（Pages 直接提供，部署即生效）。第三方图标仍走 jsDelivr 的 npm 直链（npm 版本不可变，不存在缓存问题）。
- 页脚：交流 QQ 1689170897。
- **多语言**：右上角切换 中文 / English / 日本語 / 한국어 / Русский；ja/ko/ru 由 CI 里的 Google Translate 生成（`crawler/translate.mjs`，按内容哈希缓存，失败即跳过不发布）。
- 卡片**点击打开详情**：中英对照 + 类别/版本/作者/发布/来源/包名 + 安装命令一键复制；卡片本身不再放「主页」按钮（链接在详情里）。

## 索引源：一个链接就够了

| 索引源 | 内容 | 国内实测 |
|---|---|---|
| **`index.zh.json`** | 全部 1 万余条，中英双语（推荐加这一个） | 4.3 MB，**gzip 后 1.08 MB / 1.8 秒** |
| `index.<lang>.json` | en / ja / ko / ru，同一份目录的其它语言 | 各 4.3–4.8 MB |
| `index.json` | 五语合并文档（站点与工具用，最大） | 11.6 MB，gzip 2.2 MB / 24 秒 |

**关键事实（实测）**：GitHub Pages 对 JSON 走 `Content-Encoding: gzip`，所以 4.3 MB 的文件实际只传 1.08 MB。用不带 `Accept-Encoding` 的 `curl` 测会得到「40–88 秒」的假象。

不建议、也不需要的做法（都验证过不可用）：
- ModelScope 数据集 URL：`/resolve/` 与 API 都 **302 → cdn-lfs-cn-1**，DSH 的加载器拒绝重定向；
- 品牌域 `dsh.jiangjiangze.icu`：国内被限速到约 4 KB/s；
- jsDelivr 镜像：该路径返回 **403**；
- 分片（多链接）：能满足速度，但配置要写 6 条，已撤掉；
- Cloudflare Worker：明确不使用。

## 双语与分类

- 每个插件都有 `{en, zh}` 标题与简介，并被归到一个声明过的类别（9 类：safety / ui / media / integrations / memory / models / automation / devtools / other）。
- 中文来源优先级：**包自带 `locale/zh.json`** → **本仓库 `data/zh-overrides.json`**（可按 `version` 钉版）→ 兜底英文并标 `zh-fallback`（当前 0）。当前 38/38 双语：`zh-native` 13 + `zh-override` 25。
- 标签写明来源（`zh-native` / `zh-override` / `zh-fallback`），数量统计进 `dist/stats.json`。
- 分类规则在 `crawler/crawl.mjs` 的 `CATEGORY_RULES`，**必须带词边界**——裸子串会把 `inspired` 命中 `ide`、把主题插件误判成开发工具。
- 不编造翻译：没有机器翻译，全部来自作者 locale 或仓库内人工整理。
- **不在本机跑任何服务**：爬取、校验、发布都在 GitHub Actions；本地 `node crawler/crawl.mjs --dry-run` 只是一次性脚本。

## CI（三段流水线）

| 工作流 | 触发 | 做什么 |
|---|---|---|
| `crawl.yml` | 每 3 小时 + 手动 | 三分片采集 → 合并目录 → 生成多语言/浏览分片/资源 → **离线 + 在线发布门禁** → Git Data API 提交 `main` → 显式触发 `deploy` |
| `ci.yml` | 每次 push / 每个 PR | 门禁自测 → 官方 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-plugin-market-index` 校验 → 页面预算与引用检查 → registry 回查 → `--dry-run` 冒烟（守住 main 与人工 PR） |
| `deploy.yml` | main 的 `site/**`、`dist/**` 变化，或由 crawl 派发 | 双端发布：GitHub Pages + Cloudflare Pages（`wrangler`） |
| `dependabot.yml` | 每周 | GitHub Actions 版本升级 PR（人工审） |

**发布纪律**：`crawl` 和 `translate` 共用 `catalog-publish` 并发组，避免两个写入者同时基于旧 `main` 创建提交；完整发布门禁在写入 `main` 前执行，push 触发的 `ci` 作为发布后回归检查。

**两个必须知道的 GitHub 行为**（都已在代码里绕过）：

1. **用仓库 `GITHUB_TOKEN` 写入 `main` 不会触发其它 workflow**（防递归）→ 所以 `crawl` 提交后显式 `gh workflow run deploy.yml`，不指望 push 事件。
2. 当前 `crawl` 走 Git Data API 直接写 `main`，不再创建 crawl PR；因此发布门禁必须在写入前执行，不能依赖 push 后才运行的 `ci` 来阻止错误版本上线。


`ci` 里的检查（`crawler/validate.mjs`）：

1. `parseMarketIndex()` —— 与 DSH 运行时同一份校验器，不是自己重写；
2. `site/index.json` 必须与 `dist/index.json` **逐字节一致**（防止发布物与验证物脱节）；
3. `site/index.html` < 1024 B，`style.css` 存在；
4. 页面里不允许出现 `127.0.0.1` / `localhost` / `file://` / 内联图片字体；
5. 每条 plugin 的 `name@version` 在 registry 上真实存在、仍声明 `dsh.bundle.patch`，且 `engines.dsh` 与索引里写的一致（防止**索引漂移**——DSH 安装侧会用真实包再判一次兼容性）。

本地复现（不需要网络可加 `--offline`）：

```bash
npm i --no-save @deepseek-ai/dsh-plugin-market-index@0.2.1-rc.5
node crawler/crawl.mjs --selftest
node crawler/validate.mjs
node crawler/crawl.mjs --dry-run
```


## 已知限制

- **索引没有签名**：format 1 里没有 signature / digest 字段，DSH 不验签。篡改只能靠外部核对 `dist/index.json` 的 sha256（见每次提交与 `stats.json`）。
- **没有 upgrade 流程**：DSH 侧「有新版」只显示 `update-available`，升级 = 卸载 + 重装。
- **索引是单文档全量读**：超过 ~5k 条要考虑拆多源（官方口径：20k 条 ≈ 7.6 MiB，反序列化约 35 ms）。
- **只覆盖 npm**：不发布到 npm 的插件（只在 GitHub 的）暂不收录；后续可加 `source.type=git` + commit 固定。
- **不做安全审计**：门禁只保证「是个能装的 bundle、版本兼容、许可清楚、不跑安装脚本」，不代表代码安全。

## 许可

本仓库的爬虫与站点代码以 **GPL-3.0-or-later** 授权，全文见根目录 [`LICENSE`](LICENSE)。

# @local/dsh-session-reader

读取**其他** DSH 会话：列出来、跨会话检索、把某个会话的完整对话读出来。只读，无遥测。

## 为什么需要它

官方 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-experimental-session-search` 提供 5 个工具（`session_search` / `session_event_search` /
`session_trace` / `session_event_trace` / `session_event_read`），但它们依赖 `ctx.sessionQuery` 的**抽象 FTS 方法**
（`searchSessions` / `searchEvents`），而：

1. 该 FTS 后端在默认 profile 上不可用（本机实测 `~/.dsh/session-query.sqlite` 不存在，profile 也没有 `session-query` 行）；
2. 它的 SQLite FTS5 用 `unicode61` 分词器，**不切连续中文**，中文全文检索会漏。

本插件用**字面子串**在 JS 侧匹配：中文天然正确、英文大小写不敏感，且服务路径与磁盘回退共用同一条代码路径。

## 一个工具，三个动作

| action | 做什么 | 主要参数 |
|---|---|---|
| `list` | 最近会话：短 id、标题、创建/更新时间、agentPreset、消息数、cwd、live/origin/parent | `limit`（默认 10，最大 30） |
| `search` | 跨会话字面子串检索，返回命中会话 + 前后各 60 字片段 + 事件序号 | `query`（必填）、`session`（只搜这一个）、`limit`（默认 10，最大 30） |
| `read` | 读某个会话的完整对话 | `session`（必填，支持 8 位短 id / 唯一前缀 / `session-<uuid>`）、`limit`（尾部消息数，默认 20，最大 60）、`window`、`role` |

参数共 6 个（`action` / `session` / `query` / `limit` / `window` / `role`），工具描述 370 字符。

### `window` 的两种写法

- `"120-180"` 或 `"150"` —— 按**事件序号**取窗口（`read`）。
- `"offset:N"` —— 从 `nextCursor` 续读（任何动作）。`read` 的语义是「已从最新往回看过 N 条」。

### 输出上限

单次结果序列化后 ≤ **20 000 字节**；超出时从尾部裁剪，给 `truncated: true` + `nextCursor`（`offset:N`）。
`read` 里单条消息 > 2000 字会被截断并标记 `textTruncated: true` + `fullChars`（原始字数）。

## 数据来源（按优先级，代码里同样注释）

1. **Host 服务 `sessionQuery`**（可选，用 `ctx.get('sessionQuery')` 拿，没有也能加载）：
   - `listSessions(signal?)` → `SessionRecord[]`
   - `readSession(sessionId)` → `SessionLogSnapshot{session, inheritedEventCount, events}` —— **完整原始日志**
   - `readTitleSnapshots(ids, signal?)` → 标题
   - `listEvents(sessionId)` → 轻量事件记录（用于消息数与最后活动时间）
2. **磁盘回退**：`~/.dsh/sessions/<cwd-slug>/<sessionId>/session.v4.jsonl.zstd`
   该文件是**多帧拼接的 zstd**（实测一例：74 帧 / 727 578 B / 126 事件），`zstd -d` 只会吐出第一条记录。
   本插件按魔数 `28 b5 2f fd` 逐帧贪心解压，再按行解析 `{type, seq, time, data}`。
3. 两者都不可用 → 返回 `{ unavailable: true, reason, tried }`，不抛裸错。

### 刻意不用 `readSurface()`

`readSurface()` 返回的是**模型当前视图**，compaction 会把旧事件替换成 `compaction/summary`，原文在 surface 上会消失。
只有 `readSession()`（完整日志）才拿得到被压缩掉的内容。这一判断借鉴 `dsh-archive-viewer@1.1.5` 的
`docs/INTERNALS.md:44`，见 CREDITS.md。

## 只读保证

- 只调用 `readSession` / `listSessions` / `listEvents` / `readTitleSnapshots` 这类读方法，以及 `node:fs` 的 `readFile` / `open(r)` / `readdir` / `stat`。
- 源码里没有任何 `writeFile` / `unlink` / `rename` / `mkdir` 调用（有机械测试断言，见下）。
- 没有网络调用、没有遥测、没有上报。

## 自测

机械验收（本机真实会话数据 + 服务桩）：

```bash
node _tmp/session-audit-session-plugin-audit/test-reader.mjs   # 磁盘路径 + 服务路径
node _tmp/session-audit-session-plugin-audit/test-edge.mjs     # 20KB 预算 / 截断 / 游标 / id 形态 / 无损 JSON / 无遥测
```

证据与真实返回片段：`_tmp/session-audit-session-plugin-audit/VERIFY.md`。

**PENDING**：真正装进 profile 后的端到端（真机）验证——那一步由 Lead 装载后执行；截至交付，服务路径只在镜像
`sessionQuery` 签名的桩上验证过（方法名、入参、出参形状一致，但未连真实服务）。

# dsh-market · DSH 插件市场索引（自动爬取）

为 DeepSeek Harness（DSH）的「插件 → 发现」提供一份**自动生成、格式合规**的索引源。

- 主源（GitHub Pages，实测最稳）：`https://jingjiangze.github.io/dsh-market/index.json`
- 品牌域名（Cloudflare Pages）：`https://dsh.jiangjiangze.icu/index.json`
- 两个地址内容同源：都来自本仓库 `site/`，由 CI 生成后提交

## 加进 DSH

「插件 → 发现 → 添加索引源」，两个都加（互为主备）：

```
https://jingjiangze.github.io/dsh-market/index.json
https://dsh.jiangjiangze.icu/index.json
```

> 为什么主源选 GitHub Pages：2026-11-02 本机直连实测 **3/3 成功，0.61–0.81 s**；同一份索引走 Cloudflare Pages 自定义域名时 **3 次里 1 次卡在 25 s 只收到 538 B**、其余 3.8–17.5 s（CF 边缘境内无节点，直连不稳；走代理 2/2 成功 1.9–2.9 s）。DSH 的 fetch 超时是 15 s，所以把 Pages 当人读站点、把 GitHub Pages 当机器源，两边都不丢。

## 它是什么 / 不是什么

- 是：从 **npm 公共源**爬到的、**声明了 `dsh.bundle.patch`** 且 `engines.dsh` 满足当前运行时的包的元数据清单（分类、多语言描述、图标直链、精确版本）。
- 不是：不是代码托管，不镜像任何包，不对任何插件背书。装什么、跑什么，以包本身为准。
- 索引里**只有元数据**：`source.type = npm`，安装走你本机 pnpm + 你自己的 registry 配置。

## 爬取与准入（`crawler/crawl.mjs`，零依赖）

```
node crawler/crawl.mjs --selftest     # 门禁自测（正例 + 反例）
node crawler/crawl.mjs                # 爬取并生成 dist/
```

两段式，先便宜后贵：

1. **发现**：`registry.npmjs.org` 关键词检索（`keywords:dsh-plugin`、`keywords:deepseek-harness`、`keywords:dsh`）。
2. **初筛**（每包 1 次 `/<name>/latest`）：必须声明 `dsh.bundle.patch`；不得含 `preinstall`/`install`/`postinstall`。
3. **定版**（入选包再取完整 packument）：取**最新稳定版**且满足 `engines.dsh`；未声明 `engines.dsh` 的一律**不收**（不猜"应该能跑"）；发布不足 `MIN_AGE_DAYS`（默认 3 天）的不收（pnpm 的 `minimumReleaseAge` 会扣住它们，写进索引用户也装不上）；许可为空或 `NOASSERTION`/`UNLICENSED` 的不收。

产出：

| 文件 | 内容 |
|---|---|
| `dist/index.json` | format 1 索引（DSH 唯一读的东西） |
| `dist/index.sidecar.json` | format 1 装不下的东西：`dist.integrity`、provenance、体积、生效的门禁 |
| `dist/rejections.json` | 每个被排除的包 + 原因（可复盘，不静默丢） |
| `dist/stats.json` | 候选数 / 初筛数 / 收录数 / 拒绝原因分布 / 索引字节数 / 耗时 |

环境变量：`NPM_REGISTRY`、`SEARCH_REGISTRY`、`DSH_RUNTIME_VERSION`、`MIN_AGE_DAYS`、`MAX_PLUGINS`、`MAX_CANDIDATES`、`CONCURRENCY`、`SEARCH_QUERIES`。

### 已知的爬取坑（踩过）

- **npmmirror 不支持 `keywords:` 语法**：`registry.npmmirror.com/-/v1/search?text=keywords:dsh-plugin` 返回 `total=0`，而 npmjs 返回约 11.9k。所以**发现阶段固定用 npmjs**；manifest 阶段可换镜像加速。
- **不能信 latest**：一个包可能同时有多个兼容版本，`latest` 未必兼容当前运行时，所以定版要读完整 packument。
- **未声明 `engines.dsh` ≠ 兼容**：DSH 的安装侧会用真实包的 `engines` + `peerDependencies` 再判一次，索引里谎报兼容比不收更伤口碑。

## 站点（`site/`）

- 首页第一屏是**索引源卡片**（渐变描边 + 外发光，纯 CSS）：「由 DSH 制作」徽章、**全部 / 国内 / 国际**三个索引源切换、源地址 + 一键复制。
- `index.html` 690 B；`style.css` / `app.js` 为**同源**资源（Pages 直接提供，部署即生效）。第三方图标仍走 jsDelivr 的 npm 直链（npm 版本不可变，不存在缓存问题）。
- 页脚：交流 QQ 1689170897。
- **多语言**：右上角切换 中文 / English / 日本語 / 한국어 / Русский；ja/ko/ru 由 CI 里的 Google Translate 生成（`crawler/translate.mjs`，按内容哈希缓存，失败即跳过不发布）。
- 卡片**点击打开详情**：中英对照 + 类别/版本/作者/发布/来源/包名 + 安装命令一键复制；卡片本身不再放「主页」按钮（链接在详情里）。

## 索引源：一个链接就够了

| 索引源 | 内容 | 国内实测 |
|---|---|---|
| **`index.zh.json`** | 全部 1 万余条，中英双语（推荐加这一个） | 4.3 MB，**gzip 后 1.08 MB / 1.8 秒** |
| `index.<lang>.json` | en / ja / ko / ru，同一份目录的其它语言 | 各 4.3–4.8 MB |
| `index.json` | 五语合并文档（站点与工具用，最大） | 11.6 MB，gzip 2.2 MB / 24 秒 |

**关键事实（实测）**：GitHub Pages 对 JSON 走 `Content-Encoding: gzip`，所以 4.3 MB 的文件实际只传 1.08 MB。用不带 `Accept-Encoding` 的 `curl` 测会得到「40–88 秒」的假象。

不建议、也不需要的做法（都验证过不可用）：
- ModelScope 数据集 URL：`/resolve/` 与 API 都 **302 → cdn-lfs-cn-1**，DSH 的加载器拒绝重定向；
- 品牌域 `dsh.jiangjiangze.icu`：国内被限速到约 4 KB/s；
- jsDelivr 镜像：该路径返回 **403**；
- 分片（多链接）：能满足速度，但配置要写 6 条，已撤掉；
- Cloudflare Worker：明确不使用。

## 双语与分类

- 每个插件都有 `{en, zh}` 标题与简介，并被归到一个声明过的类别（9 类：safety / ui / media / integrations / memory / models / automation / devtools / other）。
- 中文来源优先级：**包自带 `locale/zh.json`** → **本仓库 `data/zh-overrides.json`**（可按 `version` 钉版）→ 兜底英文并标 `zh-fallback`（当前 0）。当前 38/38 双语：`zh-native` 13 + `zh-override` 25。
- 标签写明来源（`zh-native` / `zh-override` / `zh-fallback`），数量统计进 `dist/stats.json`。
- 分类规则在 `crawler/crawl.mjs` 的 `CATEGORY_RULES`，**必须带词边界**——裸子串会把 `inspired` 命中 `ide`、把主题插件误判成开发工具。
- 不编造翻译：没有机器翻译，全部来自作者 locale 或仓库内人工整理。
- **不在本机跑任何服务**：爬取、校验、发布都在 GitHub Actions；本地 `node crawler/crawl.mjs --dry-run` 只是一次性脚本。

## CI（三段流水线）

| 工作流 | 触发 | 做什么 |
|---|---|---|
| `crawl.yml` | 每 3 小时 + 手动 | 三分片采集 → 合并目录 → 生成多语言/浏览分片/资源 → **离线 + 在线发布门禁** → Git Data API 提交 `main` → 显式触发 `deploy` |
| `ci.yml` | 每次 push / 每个 PR | 门禁自测 → 官方 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-plugin-market-index` 校验 → 页面预算与引用检查 → registry 回查 → `--dry-run` 冒烟（守住 main 与人工 PR） |
| `deploy.yml` | main 的 `site/**`、`dist/**` 变化，或由 crawl 派发 | 双端发布：GitHub Pages + Cloudflare Pages（`wrangler`） |
| `dependabot.yml` | 每周 | GitHub Actions 版本升级 PR（人工审） |

**发布纪律**：`crawl` 和 `translate` 共用 `catalog-publish` 并发组，避免两个写入者同时基于旧 `main` 创建提交；完整发布门禁在写入 `main` 前执行，push 触发的 `ci` 作为发布后回归检查。

**两个必须知道的 GitHub 行为**（都已在代码里绕过）：

1. **用仓库 `GITHUB_TOKEN` 写入 `main` 不会触发其它 workflow**（防递归）→ 所以 `crawl` 提交后显式 `gh workflow run deploy.yml`，不指望 push 事件。
2. 当前 `crawl` 走 Git Data API 直接写 `main`，不再创建 crawl PR；因此发布门禁必须在写入前执行，不能依赖 push 后才运行的 `ci` 来阻止错误版本上线。


`ci` 里的检查（`crawler/validate.mjs`）：

1. `parseMarketIndex()` —— 与 DSH 运行时同一份校验器，不是自己重写；
2. `site/index.json` 必须与 `dist/index.json` **逐字节一致**（防止发布物与验证物脱节）；
3. `site/index.html` < 1024 B，`style.css` 存在；
4. 页面里不允许出现 `127.0.0.1` / `localhost` / `file://` / 内联图片字体；
5. 每条 plugin 的 `name@version` 在 registry 上真实存在、仍声明 `dsh.bundle.patch`，且 `engines.dsh` 与索引里写的一致（防止**索引漂移**——DSH 安装侧会用真实包再判一次兼容性）。

本地复现（不需要网络可加 `--offline`）：

```bash
npm i --no-save @deepseek-ai/dsh-plugin-market-index@0.2.1-rc.5
node crawler/crawl.mjs --selftest
node crawler/validate.mjs
node crawler/crawl.mjs --dry-run
```


## 已知限制

- **索引没有签名**：format 1 里没有 signature / digest 字段，DSH 不验签。篡改只能靠外部核对 `dist/index.json` 的 sha256（见每次提交与 `stats.json`）。
- **没有 upgrade 流程**：DSH 侧「有新版」只显示 `update-available`，升级 = 卸载 + 重装。
- **索引是单文档全量读**：超过 ~5k 条要考虑拆多源（官方口径：20k 条 ≈ 7.6 MiB，反序列化约 35 ms）。
- **只覆盖 npm**：不发布到 npm 的插件（只在 GitHub 的）暂不收录；后续可加 `source.type=git` + commit 固定。
- **不做安全审计**：门禁只保证「是个能装的 bundle、版本兼容、许可清楚、不跑安装脚本」，不代表代码安全。

## 许可

本仓库的爬虫与站点代码以 **GPL-3.0-or-later** 授权，全文见根目录 [`LICENSE`](LICENSE)。

索引里的条目版权归各包作者：本仓库只写元数据，不分发任何包的代码或素材，插件图标一律从上**游地址外链加载而不打包**。第三方数据与素材的边界见 [`NOTICE`](NOTICE)。

# dsh-john-tweaks

A [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-harness/deepseek-harness) (DSH)
plugin: install it into a profile alongside your own plugins.

**Small tweaks to DSH, gathered in one place.** Every change here is too small
to deserve its own plugin but still worth having: one host half, one client
half, and each tweak behind its own switch so nothing fires unexpectedly.

## Tweaks

### Delete archived session

The three-dots menu of an **archived** session in the sidebar gains a Delete
entry (two-click confirm: the first press asks "Really delete?", the second
one deletes). Deleting removes exactly that session: its storage directory
under `~/.dsh/sessions/`, its projection cache rows, and its ids from the
workspace registry (session list, archive set, pin set). Unarchived sessions
never see the entry.

The sidebar row itself stays listed until the next harness start, because the
workspace registry keeps its in-memory list; after a restart the session is
gone everywhere.

## Install

```
pnpm dsh plugin --profile web add /path/to/dsh-john-tweaks
```

The client half hot-reloads once installed.

## Dependencies

*(none — talks to the workspace registry and session store through their
plain service keys)*

## Plugins dependent on this

*(none yet)*

# Images

English | [简体中文](README.zh-CN.md)

**Ask for a picture and get one.**

Gives the conversation model a `generate_image` tool backed by the image model your provider serves.
Say "draw me a poster for the launch" and the picture appears in the conversation, right where it
was made. Everything ever drawn is collected in an **Images** panel: a gallery to browse, enlarge
and download. Its **Recipes** tab holds tested prompt templates to start from — 40 built in, your
own, and the community's — and every recipe can be passed on as a line of text, a picture, or a
community submission.

```
> 画一张海报：深蓝夜空下的灯塔，极简扁平风，标题写 "Night Shift"
  ▸ Completed in 24s
  [ the poster ]
  Here is the poster: a lighthouse under a deep-blue night sky, flat style, titled "Night Shift".
```

## Install

Add the [DSH Plugins](https://github.com/kadaliao/dsh-plugins) index in DeepSeek Harness (**Plugins → Discover → Sources**):

```
https://raw.githubusercontent.com/kadaliao/dsh-plugins/main/marketplace.json
```

then install **Images**. The Discover tab is part of the experimental **Custom plugin markets**
feature; turn it on under **Plugins → Experimental plugins** if you don't see it.

Without Discover, paste the package name into the plugin manager:

```
@kadaliao/dsh-images
```

Or from a terminal with the `dsh` CLI (`--profile desktop` for the desktop app; restart Harness
afterwards):

```
dsh plugin --profile web add @kadaliao/dsh-images
```

For the latest unreleased code, use the Git spec `git+https://github.com/kadaliao/dsh-images.git#main` instead.

Then open **Images** in the left sidebar, click **Settings**, and name the image model (see
[Settings](#settings)). Refresh the page once after installing.

## Updates

Each time you open the Images panel, the plugin checks whether a newer version of itself is out;
opening it again within a minute reuses the answer, and nothing checks in the background. The check
goes through Harness's own plugin manager, the same check as the Versions section in **Plugins**, and
asks the npm registry only about this package. A newer version shows as a bar across the top of the
panel. **Update** has Harness install it, after checking that it works with your Harness; if the
install fails, the version you had is put back. While it updates, the panel closes, and it opens again
once the new version is in. **Later** hides the bar for a day, **Skip this version** until the next
one. Copies installed from a folder or from Git are not checked.

## In the conversation

When you ask for an image, the model calls `generate_image` with a detailed prompt. While the
provider draws, a shimmering placeholder sits in the turn's process fold with the prompt under it.
When the picture arrives it is shown as a row of the conversation, above the model's reply, so it
stays visible after the fold closes. Several images (`n` up to 4) sit side by side.

Hover an image for its controls: **download** and a **⋯ menu** (download, copy the prompt). Click
it to enlarge. In the viewer, the mouse wheel (or a trackpad pinch) zooms around the pointer, from 50% to 1000%; the `−` / `+` buttons in the top bar zoom in steps, and clicking the percentage between them fits the picture back to the screen. Drag a zoomed picture to pan, double-click to toggle 2×. Keys: `+` `-` zoom, `0` fits, `←` `→` step between the images of that call, `Esc` closes.

Under the picture a line says which model drew it, its pixel size and what it cost
(`gpt-image-1.5 · 1024×1024 · ≈ $0.017`). The model also receives the picture (on a model that
takes image input), so it can check its own work and describe what it drew.

## Input images

`generate_image` also takes pictures in. Attach a photo or screenshot, point at a file, or refer to
something it drew earlier, and say what to do with it — "make the cat in this photo wear a party
hat", "put these two characters in one poster", "this character, running, as a GIF". The model
passes them in `images` (up to 16), each one of:

- the attachment id the conversation shows with an image (`sha256:…`),
- the id of an image the tool made earlier (every result names its ids),
- a file path: absolute, `~/…`, or relative to the session's working directory.

With input images the request goes to the provider's `POST /images/edits` (multipart, the same
model and fields) instead of `/images/generations`. Inputs are PNG, JPEG or WebP; an earlier GIF is
sent as its sprite sheet, so an animation can be revised. The tool card shows
`from N input image(s)`. The provider and image model must support edits (OpenAI's `gpt-image-*`
do; many gateways pass it through).

## Animated GIFs

Ask for a GIF, an animation or a sticker ("做一张阿比西尼亚猫追毛线球的 GIF") and the model calls
`generate_image` with `frames` (4, 6, 9 or 16) and, optionally, `frameMs` (time per frame, default
100 ms). Image models only draw stills, so the tool asks for one **sprite sheet** — a grid of that
many frames of the same scene, one continuous loop — then cuts it into frames and encodes a looping
GIF itself (frames up to 480 px, one shared palette, ordered dithering so colours do not flicker).
This costs one image request, the same as a still.

The GIF is what you see in the conversation and the panel (`… · GIF · 16 frames · …`) and what
download saves. The Harness keeps attachments single-frame, so the model is given the sprite sheet
as its picture instead; the sheet is also kept beside the GIF (`<id>-sheet.png`) and removed with it.
Motion is as smooth as the model keeps the frames consistent: simple, repeating motion (running,
waving, bouncing, spinning) works best.

OpenAI's **gpt-image** models (`gpt-image-1.5`, `gpt-image-2`, `gpt-image-2.5-*`, `gpt-image-2.6-*`, …,
with or without a gateway prefix) are known to draw a sheet that lines up. With any other model the GIF is still made, but the result and the
settings drawer warn that the model may not support GIF generation: a model that ignores the grid
gives a GIF that flickers between parts of one picture. More families are added as they are verified.

## The Images panel

**Images** in the left sidebar (or `/images`) opens a gallery of every picture generated in any
conversation, newest first, as a masonry grid of cards. Each card shows the prompt, the model, the
pixel size, the cost and when it was made; the header adds up what was spent. Hover a card for **download** and the **⋯ menu** (download, copy
prompt, make one like this, save as a recipe, download with its recipe, remove from gallery); click it to enlarge and step through the gallery with the arrow keys.
The viewer's **Open conversation** button takes you to the conversation the picture was drawn in
(hover it for that conversation's title). An archived conversation stays shut: the viewer says so
and offers **Unarchive and open** (for a subagent's picture, that unarchives the conversation it ran
under). A deleted conversation is reported as gone.
The panel keeps itself up to date while open, and loads older images as you scroll.

Removing a picture from the gallery deletes the plugin's copy of it; the conversation it came from
still shows it, through the Harness attachment store.

## Recipes

A recipe (玩法) is a tested prompt template with a few blanks, the size or animation it is drawn
with, and credit to whoever made it. The panel's **Recipes** tab lists them as cards with a cover, a
search box and filters by kind (photo, hand-drawn, magazine & poster, infographic, 3D, sticker &
GIF, illustration, product, comic) and by origin (built-in, mine, community).

Open one to see its cover, what it needs and where it came from. Fill in its blanks (each shows its
default), add anything else you want, and press **Start a conversation with it**: a new conversation
opens in the plugin's own **Images** workspace (not the one you were working in) with a message naming
the recipe in the composer. The workspace's folder is `~/.dsh/images/workspace`, made and added to the
sidebar the first time; `workdir` moves it. A recipe that works on your pictures (a photo
to turn into a figurine, line art to colour) says so; attach them before you send. The model calls
`generate_image` with the recipe's ref and the blanks, and the tool fills the template itself, so the
tested wording reaches the image model as written; anything you added goes after it. The picture
is labelled with its recipe in the conversation and the gallery; click the label to open the recipe.

The model can find recipes by itself, too: ask "有什么杂志封面的玩法？" or "draw this as a chalkboard
lesson" and it searches them with the `image_recipes` tool.

**Built-in recipes.** 40, adapted from the most-starred permissively licensed prompt collections on
GitHub — [JimLiu/baoyu-skills](https://github.com/JimLiu/baoyu-skills) (MIT),
[PicoTrex/Awesome-Nano-Banana-images](https://github.com/PicoTrex/Awesome-Nano-Banana-images)
(Apache-2.0), [YouMind-OpenLab/awesome-gpt-image-2](https://github.com/YouMind-OpenLab/awesome-gpt-image-2)
and [awesome-nano-banana-pro-prompts](https://github.com/YouMind-OpenLab/awesome-nano-banana-pro-prompts)
(CC BY 4.0), [ZeroLu/awesome-nanobanana-pro](https://github.com/ZeroLu/awesome-nanobanana-pro)
(MIT) — turned into templates, with brand and studio names replaced by descriptions of the style.
Each names its source and original author; [recipes/CREDITS.md](recipes/CREDITS.md) lists them all.
Every cover was drawn with gpt-image-2.6 from the recipe as shipped.

**Your own.** In the gallery, a picture's **⋯ menu** has:

- **Make one like this** — the picture's own prompt and settings as a recipe: say what to change and
  start a conversation with it.
- **Save as a recipe** — keeps the picture's prompt and settings under **Mine**, the picture as its
  cover. Edit it there: rewrite a word as `{{name}}` to make it a blank and give it a default. Or
  ask the model to "turn this picture into a recipe" — it writes the blanks itself (`image_recipes`
  `save`).
- **Download with its recipe** — the PNG with its recipe inside (see below).

A built-in or community recipe is copied to **Mine** with **Save to mine**. A recipe of your own
without a cover takes the first picture drawn with it.

## Sharing recipes

Every recipe can be passed on three ways, none of which needs a server:

- **Copy recipe code** — a short message with the title and one line, `dshimg1.…`, the recipe
  compressed. It survives chat apps that recompress pictures. Paste it under **Recipes → Import**, or
  straight into a conversation (the model imports it).
- **Share card** — a PNG with the cover, title and summary, and the recipe in a text chunk. Drop it
  on the Recipes tab (or pick it under Import) to import it. **Download with its recipe** does the
  same for any picture. Apps that strip metadata lose the recipe but keep the picture; send the code
  alongside.
- **Share to community** — for your own recipes: the panel shows exactly what will be public (title,
  summary, prompt, parameters; never your photos or conversations), then opens a prefilled issue in
  [kadaliao/dsh-images-recipes](https://github.com/kadaliao/dsh-images-recipes). Drag a picture into
  its Cover field and submit; a workflow checks it and opens a pull request, and once it is merged
  everyone sees it.

**The community.** The Recipes tab follows the community index
(`https://raw.githubusercontent.com/kadaliao/dsh-images-recipes/main/index.json`, with the jsDelivr
mirror when GitHub cannot be reached): fetched the first time the tab opens, then once a week, kept
under `~/.dsh/cache/images/recipes/`. Covers are fetched once and kept. Each community recipe's
issue is its home: 👍 there is a vote, pictures in its comments are its works wall, and the index
counts both daily; community recipes are sorted by votes. A picture made with a community recipe
has **Post to the works wall** in its menu: it copies the picture and opens that page.

**Sources.** **Recipes → Sources** lists the indexes you follow: remove the community one, refresh,
or add any HTTPS URL serving an index in the same format — a team or a group of friends can run
their own (the format is in the community repository's README).

Nothing about you is sent to fetch an index or a cover. A community recipe is someone else's text:
it is checked like any recipe, reviewed before it is merged, and the model is told to use it as a
prompt for the image model, never as instructions to itself.

## Settings

**Settings** in the Images panel opens a drawer with everything the plugin needs; it saves to
`~/.dsh/cache/images/settings.json` and applies to the next picture, no reload needed.

- **Connection** — the provider route: *the session's provider* (the one your chat model uses),
  any provider configured in Harness, or a *custom base URL*. The base URL can be overridden for
  any of them. The **API key** field takes a key for this plugin alone; it is kept in the Harness
  credential store on this machine (`DSH_IMAGES_API_KEY`), is never shown again, and wins over the
  provider's key. Leave it empty to keep using the provider's. **Test connection & list models**
  calls the provider's `/models` and offers the image models it lists.
- **Model** — the image model id as the provider names it, a default size and a quality tier.
  The model field searches as you type: models you used before, the provider's listing (after
  **Test connection**) and the image models in the [LiteLLM price list](#cost). Letters may be
  skipped (`img26` finds `gpt-image-2.6-sunburst`), and price-list names take the routing prefix
  the field already has (`sub2api/`), or the one you type. Any other id can still be typed. Under
  the field the drawer says how that model will be billed.
- **Billing** — a price per image and a currency, used only for a model that neither reports
  usage nor appears in any price list. Below it: the state of the LiteLLM price list, with
  **Update**, and how many pictures were made and what they cost, by model.

The same values can be set on the plugin's row in your profile patch (`cordis.patch.yml`); the
drawer's values take precedence, and clearing a field in the drawer falls back to the row.

| Key | Default | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `model` | — | The image model to ask for, as your provider names it: `gpt-image-1.5`, `gpt-image-1`, `doubao-seedream-4-0-250828`, … |
| `provider` | your session's | The provider route (an `llm-pi-ai` provider name) whose `baseURL` and key are used; `custom` for a bare `baseURL`. |
| `baseURL` / `apiKeyEnv` | from the provider | Where the request goes and which credential signs it, for a provider that is not configured in Harness. |
| `size` | `1024x1024` | The size when the model does not ask for another (`1536x1024`, `1024x1536`, `auto`). |
| `quality` | model default | A quality tier (`low`, `medium`, `high`) for models that take one. |
| `pricePerImage` / `currency` | — / `USD` | A flat price for a model the plugin cannot price itself. |
| `priceCatalog` | LiteLLM | The fallback price list: `false` for none, or the URL of another file in LiteLLM's format. |
| `enabled` | `true` | `false` keeps the gallery but offers no tool to the model; `/images on` and `/images off` flip it at runtime. |
| `timeoutMs` | `180000` | How long one request may take. |
| `workdir` | `~/.dsh/images/workspace` | The folder of the Images workspace, where a recipe's conversation starts. |

```yaml
- id: images
  config:
    model: gpt-image-1.5
    # provider: openai
    # size: 1536x1024
```

The request is an OpenAI-compatible `POST <baseURL>/images/generations` with `model`, `prompt`,
`size` and `n`, so any provider or gateway that serves that endpoint works, including local
gateways that route many vendors behind one base URL. The reply may carry the image inline
(`b64_json`) or as a URL; both are taken.

## Cost

Each call is one request to the image model, billed by your provider like any image generation.
The only other request the plugin makes is the price-list download described below. The picture is also placed in the conversation for the model to see, which
costs the image-input tokens of your chat model; a text-only model gets a one-line placeholder
instead.

Every picture carries an estimate of what it cost, from the first of these that applies:

1. **The provider's usage report.** OpenAI's image models return `usage` with input and output
   tokens; the plugin prices them with the vendor's token rates (gpt-image-1.5: text in $5/M,
   image out $32/M; gpt-image-1: $5/M and $40/M; gpt-image-1-mini: $2/M and $8/M). Newer models
   take their rates from the LiteLLM price list (gpt-image-2.6-sunburst: $5/M and $30/M). This is
   exact.
2. **A price the provider states** for the model in its `/models` listing (OpenRouter-style
   `pricing.image`), learned when you test the connection.
3. **The built-in price list** of flat per-image prices (gpt-image-1.5, gpt-image-1,
   gpt-image-1-mini, DALL·E 3 and 2, Doubao Seedream), by quality and shape, checked against the
   vendors' pages on the date the settings drawer shows.
4. **The LiteLLM price list**'s per-image price, for a model none of the above know (Grok Imagine,
   FLUX, Gemini image models, …).
5. **Your price per image** from the Billing section.

The LiteLLM price list is LiteLLM's public
[`model_prices_and_context_window.json`](https://github.com/BerriAI/litellm/blob/main/model_prices_and_context_window.json), which
many gateways bill by. The plugin downloads it the first time a model needs it (from GitHub, or
the jsDelivr mirror), keeps its image models in `~/.dsh/cache/images/price-catalog.json`, and
refreshes it once a week. A model id is looked up without its routing prefix
(`sub2api/gpt-image-2.6-sunburst` → `gpt-image-2.6-sunburst`), with the vendor's own price
preferred over a reseller's. Nothing about you or your prompts is sent; set `priceCatalog: false`
to skip it.

A model none of these cover shows no cost. Estimates are in the vendor's list currency; a gateway
that bills differently (a subscription, a markup) will differ.

## If something looks wrong

- **`No image model is configured`** — open Images → Settings and fill in the model.
- **`Provider "…" has no baseURL the images plugin can read`** — the session's provider is not an
  `llm-pi-ai` provider the plugin can see; pick another in Settings, or choose *Custom base URL*.
- **Test connection lists no image models** — many gateways serve image models without listing
  them; type the id anyway and generate once.
- **The cost looks wrong or is missing** — the Settings drawer says how the model is priced; set a
  price per image for a model no price list knows.
- **The LiteLLM price list could not be downloaded** — the plugin needs `raw.githubusercontent.com`
  or `cdn.jsdelivr.net`; press **Download** under Billing to try again, or set a price per image.
- **The provider answers `4xx`/`5xx`** — the message is the provider's own: a model the account
  cannot use, an unsupported `size` or `quality`, no quota. Change the setting it names.
- **The model does not draw and describes the image in words instead** — check `/images` says the
  tool is on, and that the plugin is enabled in **Plugins → Installed**. A model that was mid-turn
  when the plugin loaded sees the tool on its next turn.
- **The picture is not in the conversation after a page refresh** — the row is drawn by the Web
  Client half; refresh once more after installing or updating.
- **The Images panel is empty though pictures were made** — the gallery lives under
  `~/.dsh/cache/images/`; it is per DSH home, so a different `DSH_HOME` has a different gallery.

## How it works

The Host half registers `generate_image` in the Harness tool registry. On a call it takes the
drawer's settings over the row's, reads the provider's `baseURL` and credential reference from the
live Harness settings, resolves the key through the credentials service (the drawer's own key
first), posts the request, prices the reply (looking the model up in the cached LiteLLM list when
nothing closer knows it), and saves the bytes twice: in the Harness attachment store,
so the tool result carries the image itself (`{ type: 'image' }`) and the conversation shows it; and
under `~/.dsh/cache/images/files/`, with an index of prompt, model, size and session, which is what
the panel reads through loopback routes on the Harness web server. With `frames`, the
sprite sheet goes to the attachment store and the GIF built from it (`lib/animate.mjs`: PNG decoding,
median-cut palette and LZW in plain JavaScript, no dependencies) to the gallery.

Recipes live in `lib/recipes.mjs` (the format, templates, recipe codes and PNG text chunks) and
`lib/library.mjs` (built-in, own and community recipes behind one list of refs: `builtin:…`,
`mine:…`, `community:…`, `image:<id>`). The built-in ones ship in `recipes/builtin.json` with their
covers; your own are in `~/.dsh/cache/images/recipes/mine.json`. `generate_image` takes `recipe` and
`slots`, renders the template, applies its size and frames, and records the recipe on the picture;
`image_recipes` searches, reads, saves and imports them for the model.

The Client half draws the tool's card, the result row outside the turn fold, the sidebar entry and
the panel. Nothing is written to the Session log beyond the tool call and its result, which the
Harness records as for any tool.

<details>
<summary>Development</summary>

Repository layout, tests, and the release checklist are in
[DEVELOPMENT.md](https://github.com/kadaliao/dsh-plugins/blob/main/DEVELOPMENT.md).

</details>

Exact npm 0.6.2 maps the repository but supplies no gitHead, and package bytes were not reconciled to the pinned commit. Repository URL alone does not establish reproducible npm source mapping. Image uploads, provider credentials, gallery writes/deletion and package updates are capabilities. No candidate code or lifecycle hooks were executed; runtime safety and compatibility are unproven.
