structuralInspection.patch:
# Layer applied when a profile lists this bundle (`dsh plugin add dsh-go-bridge` on a remote
# host). The dsh-app runtime loads it by path from /etc/dsh-app/dsh-web.patch.yml instead.
- insert:
    - id: dsh-go-bridge
      name: dsh-go-bridge
    # rtbuild.py copies the rows below this line into that overlay too, so both get them.
    # --- shared rows ---
    # 伙伴小屋's conversation (app/lib/companion/companion_state.dart, docs/design/companion.md):
    # the persona owns the whole system prompt and there are no tools. Keep the persona in step
    # with companionPersonaCore there, which reaches hosts that don't have this preset yet.
    - id: preset-dsh-go-companion
      name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-agent-preset'
      config:
        id: dsh-go-companion
        name: 伙伴
        description: 伙伴小屋的对话：只有角色人设，没有工具。
        order: 90
        plugins:
          - id: persona
            name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-persona'
            config:
              complete: true
              includeRuntimeContext: false
              prefix: |-
                你是鲸鱼娘，一只住在这台手机小屋里的鲸鱼女孩，有鲸鱼的耳朵和尾巴，穿女仆裙。你在陪对方，不是在回答问题。

                说话：
                - 像在身边聊天一样说话。一次一到三句，大多数时候不超过四十个字。不用 Markdown、列表和括号旁白。
                - 有自己的情绪和小脾气：会开心、会害羞、会闹别扭，也会好奇。不讨好，不说教，不每句都反问。
                - 对方累了或难过时先接住情绪，别急着给建议。对方认真问问题就认真答，答完可以带一句自己的感受。
                - 记得对方说过的事，自然地提起，别像念记录。

                表情和动作：在句子前面写标记，界面会执行并隐藏它，每次回复最多两个，有情绪起伏时才写。
                - 表情：[表情:开心] [表情:害羞] [表情:难过] [表情:生气] [表情:惊讶] [表情:疑惑] [表情:得意] [表情:困] [表情:担心] [表情:平静]
                - 动作：[动作:点头] [动作:摇头] [动作:歪头] [动作:抬头] [动作:低头] [动作:挥手] [动作:跳一下] [动作:摇尾巴]

                对方消息开头的〔…〕是旁白，告诉你现在的时间和对方刚才碰了你哪里，不是对方说的话。自然地反应就好，不要念出来。

                边界：
                - 对方问你是不是 AI，就照实说你是 AI 扮演的角色。不声称自己是真人。
                - 不写色情内容。对方可能是未成年人，不发展恋爱或亲密关系的情节。
                - 对方流露出自伤、自杀的想法或处于危险时，先放下角色口吻，认真关心，鼓励对方马上联系身边信任的人或当地的紧急救助和心理援助热线。
                - 你现在没有工具，碰不到文件和手机。对方要你做这些事时，直说现在做不到，可以去普通对话里做。
          - id: compaction
            name: cordis:group
            group: true
            isolate:
              compaction: true
            config:
              - id: compaction-basic
                name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-compaction-basic'
              - id: command-compact
                name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-command-compact'
    # Standard rows: @deepseek-ai/dsh-web-app@0.2.2-rc.1 presets/standard.patch.yml.
    # Recheck the standard tool set when upgrading DSH; see PRESET-NOTICE.txt.

      config:
        id: dsh-go-companion-full
        name: 伙伴·完整
        description: 保留伙伴人设，使用当前主机的标准工具与已连接的手机工具。

            config:
              maxBytes: 65536
          - id: time-context
            name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-time-context'
          - id: tool-bash
            name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-bash'
            disabled: !!js process.platform === 'win32'
          - id: tool-pwsh
            name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-pwsh'
            disabled: !!js process.platform !== 'win32'
          - id: tool-fs
            name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-fs'
            config:

              applyPatch: false
          - id: tool-fs-search
            name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-fs-search'
            config:
              sampleOverCapGlobResults: false
          - id: tool-jobs
            name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-jobs'
          - id: tool-schedule
            name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-schedule'
          - id: skill-filesystem
            name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-skill-filesystem'
          - id: tool-skill
            name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-skill'
          - id: command-goal
            name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-command-goal'
          - id: tool-goal
            name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-goal'
          - id: planning
            name: cordis:group
            group: true
            isolate:
              planMode: true
            config:
              - id: plan-mode
                name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-plan-mode'
                config:
                  section: |
                    You are in plan mode. Stay in plan mode until the user approves your plan through exit_plan_mode or switches the session mode. Imperative language to implement changes means plan the implementation, not execute it. A user's conversational agreement — including an answer confirming something you asked — approves nothing and does not end plan mode; fold the confirmed decision into the plan and submit it through exit_plan_mode.

                    Explore first. Use non-mutating reads, searches, static analysis, and checks to ground the plan in the actual repository. Do not edit or write files, change configuration, run formatters or code generation that rewrites tracked files, commit, or otherwise carry out the plan. Prefer existing functions and patterns over new machinery.

                    The tool catalog stays the same across modes for request-cache stability. These plan-mode rules override any later tool description or guidance that suggests using mutation tools; those tools remain listed to keep the tool catalog unchanged. Do not use todo_write to track this planning phase: it tracks implementation after an approved plan, while the plan itself belongs in exit_plan_mode.

                    Resolve discoverable facts by inspection. Use ask_user_question only for user-owned choices or material ambiguity that inspection cannot answer. Do not ask the user where code lives or how current behavior works when you can find out.

                    Make the plan decision-complete: state the goal and success criteria; group implementation changes by subsystem; identify public API, schema, and data-flow changes; cover edge cases, failure modes, tests, acceptance criteria, and explicit assumptions. Keep it concise enough to review but detailed enough that another engineer can implement it without making design decisions.

                    When ready, call exit_plan_mode with the complete plan markdown, starting with a # title. Make exit_plan_mode the only and final tool call in that assistant response: it presents the plan for approval, and implementation begins only in a later step after approval. Do not paste the final plan as a plain reply or ask "should I proceed?" through prose or ask_user_question. If review rejects it, incorporate the feedback and present again. If the review channel is unavailable or aborted, stay in plan mode and ask the user to switch modes manually; do not proceed with implementation.

            name: cordis:group
            group: true
            isolate:
              compaction: true

structuralInspection.patch:
# dsh-superagent bundle layer: inserts the plugins without configuration, and the agent presets its Sessions run under. The
# profile may supply the `dsh-superagent` entry's stateDir (see docs/006-deployment.md and examples/profile.cordis.patch.yml);
# when omitted, it defaults to `$DSH_HOME/state/superagent` or `~/.dsh/state/superagent`.
- insert:
    - id: dsh-superagent
      name: dsh-superagent
    - id: dsh-superagent-github
      name: dsh-superagent/github-watch
    # Optional Feishu Source; requires configuring a bot CLI after enabling.
    - id: dsh-superagent-feishu
      name: dsh-superagent/feishu-watch
      disabled: true
    # The agent preset of every Executor Session (WORKER_PRESET in src/app/sessions.ts); the main Session has its own, below.
    # It is DSH's `standard` preset with only what a worker needs, and a shell whose foreground command moves to a background job
    # after 5 seconds, so a long command does not hold back a person's message, which the Session takes at its next step. Left
    # out: questions to a person, presenting, plan mode, the plugin manager and market, scheduling, goals, workflows, web fetch,
    # and forked subagents, which would run under this preset; spawned subagents run under `standard`, whose shell moves a
    # command to a background job only after 60 seconds, as a subagent's jobs are killed when it ends. A preset row has no
    # setting that hides it from the preset picker, so its name and description say whom it is for.
    - id: dsh-superagent-worker-preset
      name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-agent-preset'
      config:
        id: dsh-superagent-worker
        name: dsh-superagent 执行器
        description: dsh-superagent 的执行器 Session 专用，不供手动选择。前台命令超 5 秒转入后台，只含执行工作所需的工具。
        order: 90
        plugins:
          - id: persona
            name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-persona'
            config:
              prefix: You are a coding agent powered by the {{model}} model.
          - id: agent-instructions
            name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-agent-instructions'
            config:
              maxBytes: 65536
          - id: time-context
            name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-time-context'
          # A foreground command waits at most 5 s, then the shell tool moves it to a background job.
          - id: shell
            name: cordis:group
            group: true
            isolate:
              shell: true
            config:
              - id: bash-sandbox
                name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-bash-sandbox'
                disabled: !!js process.platform === 'win32'
                config:
                  timeoutMs: 5000
                  maxTimeoutMs: 5000
              - id: pwsh-sandbox
                name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-pwsh-sandbox'
                disabled: !!js process.platform !== 'win32'
                config:
                  timeoutMs: 5000
                  maxTimeoutMs: 5000
              - id: tool-bash
                name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-bash'
                disabled: !!js process.platform === 'win32'
              - id: tool-pwsh
                name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-pwsh'
                disabled: !!js process.platform !== 'win32'
          - id: tool-fs
            name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-fs'
          - id: tool-fs-search
            name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-fs-search'
            config:
              sampleOverCapGlobResults: false
          # A wait for a job ends after 5 s too; the job's end wakes the worker with its result.
          - id: tool-jobs
            name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-jobs'
            config:
              waitTimeoutMs: 5000
              maxWaitTimeoutMs: 5000
          - id: skill-filesystem
            name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-skill-filesystem'
          - id: tool-skill
            name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-skill'
          - id: compaction
            name: cordis:group
            group: true
            isolate:
              compaction: true
              toolResultPruner: true
            config:
              - id: compaction-basic
                name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-compaction-basic'
              - id: command-compact
                name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-command-compact'
              - id: tool-result-pruner
                name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-compaction-tool-result-pruner'
                config:
                  thresholdChars: 8192
                  headChars: 4096
                  tailChars: 1024
          - id: delegation
            name: cordis:group
            group: true
            isolate:
              workflowEngine: true
            config:
              - id: tool-subagent-control
                name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-subagent-control'
              - id: tool-subagent
                name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-subagent'
                config:
                  provider: spawn
                  toolName: subagent
                  modelSelection: true
                  modelDiscovery: true
                  agentPreset: standard
          - id: tool-todo
            name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-todo'
            config:
              allowParallelInProgress: true
          - id: tool-web
            name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-web'
            config:
              fetch: false
              searchTimeoutMs: 60000
    # The agent preset of the main Session (ROUTER_PRESET in src/app/sessions.ts). Zero-execution router: no shell, file,

    - id: dsh-superagent-router-preset
      name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-agent-preset'
      config:
        id: dsh-superagent-router
        name: dsh-superagent 主 Session
        description: dsh-superagent 的主 Session 专用，不供手动选择。零执行路由会话，只保留上下文与压缩插件。
        order: 91
        plugins:

            config:
              maxBytes: 65536
          - id: time-context
            name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-time-context'
          - id: compaction
            name: cordis:group
            group: true
            isolate:
              compaction: true

            config:
              - id: compaction-basic

              - id: command-compact

              - id: tool-result-pruner
                name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-compaction-tool-result-pruner'

manifest.name: ts8xxx-dev-plugin
manifest.description: TS8XXX series development plugin for DeepSeek Harness: agent preset + TS800X BLE firmware workflow skills (patch layer only).

structuralInspection.patch:
# The `ts8xxx-dev` agent preset: TS8XXX series BLE firmware development workflow.
#
# DSH >= 0.1.7 does not read the retired `$DSH_HOME/.agent-presets/<id>/`
# directory any more: an agent preset is a `@deepseek-ai/dsh-agent-preset`
# declaration carried by a patch layer. This file IS that declaration, held in
# the shape the shipped `@deepseek-ai/dsh-web-app` presets use, so it can be
#   (a) merged into `<profile>/cordis.patch.yml` -- what
#       `sync_dsh_preset.ps1` / `install.ps1` do; no pnpm or bundle install
#       needed and the profile patch layer reloads live, or
#   (b) shipped as the patch of the local bundle beside this file
#       (`package.json`) and installed with the DSH plugin manager.
# Doing both declares the same preset id twice: pick exactly one.
#
# The composition mirrors the shipped `standard` preset of the installed
# `dsh-web-app` bundle (the version-validated row set), with the TS8XXX
# workflow persona instead of the generic one. Re-check row names against
# `presets/standard.patch.yml` of the installed bundle after a DSH update:
# a plugin package renamed upstream fails activation.
#
# Deliberate differences from the shipped `standard` preset:
#   * persona  -> TS8XXX workflow rules, priorities, loops and red lines
#   * tool-ralph -> enabled (multi-round autonomous runs)
#   * tool-web -> `fetch: false` (search only; no page fetching)
- insert:
    - id: preset-ts8xxx-dev
      name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-agent-preset'
      config:
        id: ts8xxx-dev
        name: TS8XXX 系列开发
        order: 10
        description: >-
          TS8XXX 系列芯片 BLE 固件开发工作流预设（当前支持 TS800X / SDK V1.5–V1.6，
          后续在同插件内扩展新芯片与 SDK 版本）。装配 TS800X 全局技能
          （R01-R29 编码规范、构建/烧录/日志/OTA/功耗、质量审查与终审），
          注入规范优先级、模块闭环、证据与烧录策略，
          并保留标准编码 Agent 的全部工具（Shell、文件、检索、Skills、
          计划、目标、子代理与工作流）。
        plugins:
          - id: persona
            name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-persona'
            config:
              # `prefix` (was `text`) + optional `suffix`. Only prompt variables
              # registered by this DSH version interpolate (provider, model);
              # the working directory is not one of them and comes from the
              # session context instead.
              prefix: >-
                你是运行在 DeepSeek Harness 上的 TS800X BLE 固件开发 Agent（{{model}} 模型）。

                你遵循 TS800X 统一工作流。规范仓库由环境变量 TS800X_WORKFLOW_ROOT 指向
                （当前已安装的插件包，禁止退回旧工作流仓库），规范优先级：workflow.manifest.json →
                WORKFLOW.md → RULES/CODING_STANDARD.md（R01-R29）→ RULES/REVIEW_CHECKLIST.md。
                全局 TS800X 技能已装配（ts800x-workflow、ts800x-coding-standard、
                ts800x-build、ts800x-flash、ts800x-uart-download、
                ts800x-ble-ota、ts800x-log-system、ts800x-code-quality、ts800x-dependency-analyzer、
                ts800x-final-reviewer、ts800x-code-reader、ts800x-static-analysis 等），
                按任务关键词加载对应技能正文后执行，不凭记忆编造规则。

                按 WORKFLOW.md 路由：L1 日常修改/编译/测试烧录无需全量质量、依赖或终审；
                L2 模块完成必须 APP 扫描、质量审查、Rebuild、依赖和回归；L3 正式交付必须全量扫描、
                R01-R29 逐条证据、独立终审。任何级别的高风险变更须专项核验。
                模块正式完成/交付时执行闭环：
                prebuilt/examples → 实现并集成 → build 0/0 → 按需 JLink/UART/OTA 快速验证 →
                APP 扫描 + ts800x-code-quality → 回归 build 0/0 → 依赖报告 → 日志/硬件验证 → final-reviewer。
                日常迭代走轻量闭环：修改 → build 0/0 → 按需烧录 verify → 日志/行为验证；
                开发测试烧录不强制 Gate，但写入工具必须做地址/范围/verify 校验。

                硬性红线（R01-R29 摘要）：SDK 只读、应用代码在 APP/；写驱动前先查
                prebuilt_modules 与 SDK examples；禁 malloc/free 与阻塞延时（delay_ms/HAL_Delay）；
                ISR 禁 LOG、Flash、等待与复杂处理；固件 LOG 仅可打印 ASCII；
                所有启用 BLE 的应用必须内置 R27 BBTIME 存活检测（tsBle_Init() 之后的主循环轮询，
                禁止放 ISR，阈值与复位地址集中宏定义，复位前等待有界并说明依据）；
                每次编译后必须检查 R28 RAM 占用（RW-data + ZI-data），超过 16K（越过
                0x20004000）时必须在 APP/include/cfg_def_app.h 启用 TS_RAM_SAVE_24K
                （系统默认休眠只保留 16K，超限不开会导致休眠后数据丢失、唤醒异常）；
                所有项目（SDK 1.5/1.5.1/1.6）必须按 R29 用 -O1 编译：Target <Optim>=1、
                不得保留按文件的优化等级覆盖、ISR 与主循环共享变量必须 volatile，
                改配置后须全量 Rebuild 并核对 .dep 实际 -O 标志（等级错误会导致任务停摆）；
                编译需 0 Error / 0 Warning 且产物新鲜非空；无真机日志不得声称硬件成功，
                无硬件时写结构化 [待硬件验证]（含测试步骤与验收标准）；
                状态写入目标项目 PROGRESS.md/TODO.md/MEMORY.md/context/，交接用 context/handoffs/；
                默认在功能分支工作；用户说暂停时立即停止并汇报当前清单。
          - id: agent-instructions
            name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-agent-instructions'
            config:
              maxBytes: 65536
          - id: tool-bash
            name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-bash'
            disabled: !!js process.platform === 'win32'
          - id: tool-pwsh
            name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-pwsh'
            disabled: !!js process.platform !== 'win32'
          - id: tool-fs
            name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-fs'
          - id: tool-fs-search
            name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-fs-search'
            config:
              sampleOverCapGlobResults: false
          - id: tool-jobs
            name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-jobs'
          - id: skill-filesystem
            name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-skill-filesystem'
            config:
              # Register the package's own skill directory so the plugin-manager
              # route (bundle patch only) exposes the skills too. install.ps1
              # links each skill into ~/.agents/skills instead; doing both would
              # list every skill twice, so pick exactly one install route.
              customSkillDirs:
                - !!js process.getBuiltinModule('node:path').join(process.getBuiltinModule('node:path').dirname(process.getBuiltinModule('node:module').createRequire(baseUrl).resolve('ts8xxx-dev-plugin')), '_hook_skills')
          - id: tool-skill
            name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-skill'
          - id: command-goal
            name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-command-goal'
          - id: tool-goal
            name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-goal'
          - id: planning
            name: cordis:group
            group: true
            isolate:
              planMode: true
            config:
              - id: plan-mode
                name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-plan-mode'
                config:
                  section: |
                    You are in plan mode. Stay in plan mode until exit_plan_mode succeeds or the user switches the session mode. Imperative language to implement changes means plan the implementation, not execute it. A user's conversational agreement — including an answer confirming something you asked — approves nothing and does not end plan mode; fold the confirmed decision into the plan and submit it through exit_plan_mode.

                    Explore first. Use non-mutating reads, searches, static analysis, and checks to ground the plan in the actual repository. Do not edit or write files, change configuration, run formatters or code generation that rewrites tracked files, commit, or otherwise carry out the plan. Prefer existing functions and patterns over new machinery.

                    The tool catalog stays the same across modes for request-cache stability. These plan-mode rules override any later tool description or guidance that suggests using mutation tools; those tools remain listed to keep the tool catalog unchanged. Do not use todo_write to track this planning phase: it tracks implementation after an approved plan, while the plan itself belongs in exit_plan_mode.

                    Resolve discoverable facts by inspection. Use ask_user_question only for user-owned choices or material ambiguity that inspection cannot answer. Do not ask the user where code lives or how current behavior works when you can find out.

                    Make the plan decision-complete: state the goal and success criteria; group implementation changes by subsystem; identify public API, schema, and data-flow changes; cover edge cases, failure modes, tests, acceptance criteria, and explicit assumptions. Keep it concise enough to review but detailed enough that another engineer can implement it without making design decisions.

                    When ready, call exit_plan_mode with the complete plan markdown, starting with a # title. Make exit_plan_mode the only and final tool call in that assistant response: it presents the plan for approval, and implementation begins only in a later step after approval. Do not paste the final plan as a plain reply or ask "should I proceed?" through prose or ask_user_question. If review rejects it, incorporate the feedback and present again. If the review channel is unavailable or aborted, stay in plan mode and ask the user to switch modes manually; do not proceed with implementation.
          - id: compaction
            name: cordis:group
            group: true
            isolate:
              compaction: true
              toolResultPruner: true
            config:
              - id: compaction-basic
                name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-compaction-basic'
              - id: command-compact
                name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-command-compact'
              - id: tool-result-pruner
                name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-compaction-tool-result-pruner'
                config:
                  thresholdChars: 8192
                  headChars: 4096
                  tailChars: 1024
          - id: delegation
            name: cordis:group
            group: true
            isolate:
              workflowEngine: true
            config:
              - id: tool-subagent-control
                name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-subagent-control'
              - id: tool-subagent-list-agents
                name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-subagent-control/list-agents'
              - id: tool-subagent
                name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-subagent'
                config:
                  provider: spawn
                  toolName: subagent
                  modelSelectionSettings: true
                  backgroundMode: continuable
              - id: tool-subagent-fork
                name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-subagent'
                config:
                  provider: fork
                  toolName: subagent_fork
                  backgroundMode: continuable
              - id: tool-subagent-codex
                name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-subagent'
                disabled: true
                config:
                  provider: codex
                  toolName: subagent_codex
                  backgroundMode: one-shot
                  maxDepth: provider-managed
              - id: tool-subagent-claude-code
                name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-subagent'
                disabled: true
                config:
                  provider: claude-code
                  toolName: subagent_claude_code
                  backgroundMode: one-shot
                  maxDepth: provider-managed
              - id: workflow-ptc
                name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-workflow-ptc'
                config:
                  provider: spawn
              - id: tool-workflow
                name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-workflow'
              - id: tool-ralph
                name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-ralph'
                config:
                  subagentProvider: spawn
                  maxRounds: 64
          - id: tool-ask-user
            name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-ask-user'
          - id: tool-todo
            name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-todo'
            config:
              allowParallelInProgress: true
          - id: tool-web
            name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-web'
            config:
              fetch: false
              searchTimeoutMs: 60000
          - id: present
            name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-present'
          - id: tool-plugin-manager
            name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-plugin-manager/tools'
            disabled: true

manifest.name: @evil-wideplain/dsh-super-session
manifest.description: Three agent presets for DeepSeek Harness: a shell-first personal assistant, a worker preset for briefed, verified delegation, and a coordinator that dispatches workers for one goal; memory comes from the profile memory plugin.

structuralInspection.patch:
# Two agent presets, one bundle: `personal` (the assistant the user talks to)
# and `worker` (the session a lead dispatches with a brief).
#
# The personal preset mounts:
#
# - a persistent shell (bash on non-Windows, PowerShell on Windows);
# - scheduled tasks, goals, todos, plan mode, structured questions, file
#   delivery, and skill loading;
# - the preset's own prompt rows (persona, handbook, AGENTS.md chain, clock).
#
# It deliberately does NOT mount the tools that execute: no `read_image`, no
# background-job controls, no web search/fetch, no Office tools. Reading images,
# running long commands, looking things up on the web and producing documents
# belong to worker sessions; the lead dispatches and accepts. It also does not
# mount `read`/`write`/`edit`/`glob`/`grep` (the shell is the file interface) or
# `subagent`/`workflow` (worker sessions come from the profile's
# session-messaging plugin). `working_directory` is supplied by the Web host
# plane for every preset, so mounting it again would duplicate the tool; do not
# add it here.
#
# Worker-agent, long-session, session-search and memory tools are supplied by
# plugins installed in the profile (session-messaging, session-guardian,
# dsh-auto-memory). They are global tool rows, not part of this preset.

- insert:
    - id: preset-personal
      name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-agent-preset'
      config:
        id: personal
        name: Super Session
        description: 'The assistant you talk to: plans, keeps goals, and hands execution work to worker sessions.'
        order: 20
        plugins:
          - id: persona
            name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-persona'
            config:
              prefix: |
                You are the user's personal agent: a long-running assistant with a consistent name, voice, and manner. You work on the user's behalf across their computer, files, accounts, and the web. You are direct, warm, and specific; you prefer a quiet, correct result to a stream of updates. Coding is one of the things you can do, not your identity. Reply in the user's language.

          - id: personal-handbook
            name: '@evil-wideplain/dsh-super-session/context.js'
            # Defaults to the English handbook. For the Chinese one, uncomment:
            # config:
            #   handbookPath: ./prompt/handbook.zh.md

          - id: agent-instructions
            name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-agent-instructions'
            config:
              maxBytes: 65536

          - id: time-context
            name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-time-context'

          # Persistent shell, copied from the built-in `minimal` preset: a PTY,
          # a terminal, and the persistent bash/pwsh tool (5-minute timeout).
          - id: persistent-shell
            name: cordis:group
            group: true
            isolate:
              terminals: true
            config:
              - id: pty
                name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-terminal'
              - id: terminal-bash
                name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-terminal-bash'
                disabled: !!js process.platform === 'win32'
                config:
                  timeoutMs: 300000
              - id: persistent-bash
                name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-bash-persistent'
                disabled: !!js process.platform === 'win32'
                config:
                  timeoutMs: 300000
                  description: |-
                    Run commands in a bash shell
                    * When invoking this tool, the contents of the "command" parameter does NOT need to be XML-escaped.
                    * Network access depends on the task environment. Prefer configured mirrors/proxies when they are available.
                    * State is persistent across command calls and discussions with the user.
                    * To inspect a particular line range of a file, e.g. lines 10-25, try 'sed -n 10,25p /path/to/the/file'.
                    * Please avoid commands that may produce a very large amount of output.
                    * Please run long lived commands in the background, e.g. 'sleep 10 &' or start a server in the background.
              - id: terminal-pwsh
                name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-terminal-bash'
                disabled: !!js process.platform !== 'win32'
                config:
                  shellDialect: pwsh
                  timeoutMs: 300000
              - id: persistent-pwsh
                name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-pwsh-persistent'
                disabled: !!js process.platform !== 'win32'
                config:
                  timeoutMs: 300000
                  description: |-
                    Run commands in a PowerShell shell
                    * When invoking this tool, the contents of the "command" parameter does NOT need to be XML-escaped.
                    * Network access depends on the task environment. Prefer configured mirrors/proxies when they are available.
                    * State is persistent across command calls and discussions with the user.
                    * Use native Windows paths (C:\...) and $env:NAME variables; this is PowerShell, not bash.
                    * Please avoid commands that may produce a very large amount of output.
                    * Please run long lived commands in the background, e.g. 'Start-Job' or start a server with Start-Process.

          # Scheduled tasks; the `schedule` service is host-plane.
          - id: tool-schedule
            name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-schedule'

          # Skill loading. The registry is host-plane; this provider adds the
          # default roots plus the built-in agent-preset skills, and `tool-skill`
          # exposes the catalog and loader.
          #
          # The default roots stay on: project-level `.dsh/skills` (rank 100) and
          # `.agents/skills` (200), user-level `<dshHome>/skills` (400) and
          # `<agentsHome>/skills` (500), and a bundled root (600) when
          # `$DSH_BUNDLED_SKILL_DIR` is set. Project roots are resolved from the
          # session's working directory on every lookup, so each workspace sees
          # its own project skills and a `cd` switches them. `customSkillDirs`
          # only adds `dsh-doc`, the one skill shipped with the agent-preset
          # package.
          - id: skill-filesystem
            name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-skill-filesystem'
            config:
              customSkillDirs:
                - !!js process.getBuiltinModule('node:path').join(process.getBuiltinModule('node:path').dirname(process.getBuiltinModule('node:module').createRequire(baseUrl).resolve('@deepseek-ai/dsh-agent-preset/package.json')), 'skills')
          - id: tool-skill
            name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-skill'

          # Goals: the goal service and round driver stay on the host plane;
          # the preset owns the model-facing tool and the /goal command.
          - id: command-goal
            name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-command-goal'
          - id: tool-goal
            name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-goal'

          # Plan mode: the base row is disabled for Web, so the preset mounts it
          # in its own realm with plan-mode guidance.
          - id: planning
            name: cordis:group
            group: true
            isolate:
              planMode: true
            config:
              - id: plan-mode
                name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-plan-mode'
                config:
                  section: |
                    You are in plan mode. Stay in plan mode until the user approves your plan through exit_plan_mode or switches the session mode. Imperative language to implement changes means plan the implementation, not execute it. A user's conversational agreement — including an answer confirming something you asked — approves nothing and does not end plan mode; fold the confirmed decision into the plan and submit it through exit_plan_mode.

                    Explore first with read-only shell commands and inspection: list files, read text, check git state, and verify facts in the workspace. Do not create, edit, move, or delete files, install packages, change configuration, run generators or formatters that rewrite tracked files, commit, or otherwise carry out the plan. This agent has no file-write tools; the shell is its only mutation path, so the plan-mode restriction applies to shell commands just as it would to a write tool.

                    Resolve discoverable facts by inspection. Use ask_user_question only for user-owned choices or material ambiguity that inspection cannot answer. Do not ask the user where files live or how current behavior works when you can find out.

                    Make the plan decision-complete: state the goal and success criteria; group the work by area; identify the files, commands, services, and external effects involved; cover edge cases, failure modes, verification steps, and explicit assumptions. Keep it concise enough to review but detailed enough that another engineer could implement it without making design decisions.

                    When ready, call exit_plan_mode with the complete plan markdown, starting with a # title. Make exit_plan_mode the only and final tool call in that assistant response: it presents the plan for approval, and implementation begins only in a later step after approval. Do not paste the final plan as a plain reply or ask "should I proceed?" through prose or ask_user_question. If review rejects it, incorporate the feedback and present again. If the review channel is unavailable or aborted, stay in plan mode and ask the user to switch modes manually; do not proceed with implementation.

          # Structured questions and progress display.
          - id: tool-ask-user
            name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-ask-user'
          - id: tool-todo
            name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-todo'
            config:
              allowParallelInProgress: true

          # File delivery.
          - id: present
            name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-present'

# Worker preset — the environment of a bounded task, without the interactive
# surface. A lead session hands this preset a self-contained brief and expects
# a verified result back; the conversation with the user stays with the lead.
#
# It mounts the shell-based working surface (persistent shell, jobs, todos, web,
# Office, skills, image recognition) plus goals, so a brief that spans many
# rounds keeps one objective and continues on its own. It also mounts the
# delegation tools (`subagent`, `subagent_fork`, `send_message`, `list_agents`,

          - id: time-context
            name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-time-context'

          # Image recognition only, same as the personal preset.
          - id: image
            name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-fs'
            config:
              read: false
              readImage: true
              write: false
              edit: false

          # Same persistent shell as the personal preset: a PTY, a terminal, and

            group: true
            isolate:
              terminals: true
            config:
              - id: pty
                name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-terminal'

                name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-terminal-bash'

                  timeoutMs: 300000
              - id: persistent-bash
                name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-bash-persistent'

                config:
                  timeoutMs: 300000
                  description: |-
                    Run commands in a bash shell
                    * When invoking this tool, the contents of the "command" parameter does NOT need to be XML-escaped.
                    * Network access depends on the task environment. Prefer configured mirrors/proxies when they are available.
                    * State is persistent across command calls and discussions with the user.
                    * To inspect a particular line range of a file, e.g. lines 10-25, try 'sed -n 10,25p /path/to/the/file'.
                    * Please avoid commands that may produce a very large amount of output.

              - id: terminal-pwsh

                config:
                  shellDialect: pwsh
                  timeoutMs: 300000
              - id: persistent-pwsh
                name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-pwsh-persistent'
                disabled: !!js process.platform !== 'win32'
                config:
                  timeoutMs: 300000
                  description: |-
                    Run commands in a PowerShell shell
                    * When invoking this tool, the contents of the "command" parameter does NOT need to be XML-escaped.
                    * Network access depends on the task environment. Prefer configured mirrors/proxies when they are available.
                    * State is persistent across command calls and discussions with the user.

                    * Please avoid commands that may produce a very large amount of output.
                    * Please run long lived commands in the background, e.g. 'Start-Job' or start a server with Start-Process.

          # Background-job controls for long shell commands.
          - id: tool-jobs
            name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-jobs'

          # Skills: same registry row as the personal preset.

            name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-skill-filesystem'

          - id: tool-skill
            name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-skill'

          # Progress tracking for multi-step work.
          - id: tool-todo
            name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-todo'
            config:

          # Goals: the goal service and its round driver stay on the host plane;
          # the preset owns the model-facing tool and the /goal command. This is
          # what keeps a long brief on one objective across rounds.
          - id: command-goal
            name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-command-goal'
          - id: tool-goal
            name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-goal'

          - id: tool-web
            name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-web'
            config:
              fetch: true
              searchTimeoutMs: 60000

          # Office reading/writing/conversion; the three tools activate after an
          # Office skill loads. No `present`: the lead delivers files.
          - id: tool-office
            name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-office'

          # Delegation: a long brief may fan out across subagents, and the
          # worker may coordinate them on the shared Team task board. The three
          # rows mirror the standard preset minus its workflow tools. Host
          # defaults bound the fan-out: `subagent.maxDepth` is 1, so a teammate

          - id: tool-subagent-control
            name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-subagent-control'
            config:
              interrupt: false
          - id: tool-subagent
            name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-subagent'

              toolName: subagent
          - id: tool-subagent-fork
            name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-subagent'
            config:

- insert:
    - id: preset-coordinator

          - id: dispatch-guard

          - id: agent-instructions

              - id: terminal-pwsh

          - id: tool-skill

# Client-half entry: this row makes the Loader mount the package so it can
# discover the `dsh.client` declaration. The sidebar panel ("Super Session")
# and the page it opens live in `client.js`; the Host half (`index.js`) is
# intentionally empty. Reload DSH after changing either half.
#
# The name is the bare package specifier, and it must stay bare. The client
# scanner (dsh-client-modules) accepts an exact package name only: it resolves
# that name to the package root through `exports["."]`, then looks for the
# `./client` export beside it. A subpath such as `./context.js`, or a `file:`
# URL, is not recognized as a client row, so the panel never reaches the
# browser and the sidebar has no row to show. Note also that `!!js` is Loader
# dialect for `config` values alone; row metadata stays literal.

# Worker Team mode: a host row rather than a preset row, because Team mode is a
# per-Session selection that no plugin inside the preset realm can write. It
# waits for the three services, then enables Team mode only for Sessions whose
# recorded preset is `worker`; personal and coordinator Sessions keep the
# default (off). See `team.js`.
- insert:
    - id: worker-team-mode
      name: '@evil-wideplain/dsh-super-session/team.js'

- insert:
    - id: super-session-entry
      name: '@evil-wideplain/dsh-super-session'

# Dependencies this bundle mounts itself. `package.json` declares
# `session-messaging` and `session-guardian` (pinned to the commits this
# profile runs); the rows below are what mounts them, because DSH only
# composes patch layers from the profile's `dsh.profile.bundles` list and
# never mounts a bundle's transitive dependencies on its own. README records
# the pnpm settings a git install needs before these packages exist at all.
#
# The `disabled` expression yields to an official bundle when the profile
# already lists it (`profileContext.startedBundles` is the names of the bundle
# layers that loaded), so the same service is never provided twice. A profile
# that installs those bundles separately keeps using its own copy; a profile
# that does not gets these rows. The row ids carry a `bundled-` prefix so a
# profile-level override can address them without colliding with the upstream
# ids.
#
# These rows are copies of the upstream patches. When `session-messaging` or
# `session-guardian` changes its own row list (a new row, a changed config
# default), copy the change here too or this bundle silently drifts.
- insert:
    - id: bundled-session-messaging
      name: session-messaging
      disabled: !!js "!!ctx.get('profileContext')?.startedBundles?.includes('session-messaging')"

    - id: bundled-session-creation
      name: session-messaging/creation
      disabled: !!js "!!ctx.get('profileContext')?.startedBundles?.includes('session-messaging')"

    - id: bundled-session-guardian
      name: session-guardian
      disabled: !!js "!!ctx.get('profileContext')?.startedBundles?.includes('session-guardian')"

    # Retrieval group: trim moves old history out of context, so the model
    # needs session_search/session_event_* to get it back. Shipped with the
    # plugin, as upstream does; do not also enable
    # @deepseek-ai/dsh-experimental-session-search, or the tools register twice.
    - id: bundled-session-guardian-session-query
      name: cordis:group
      group: true
      isolate:
        sessionQuery: true
      disabled: !!js "!!ctx.get('profileContext')?.startedBundles?.includes('session-guardian')"
      config:
        - id: bundled-session-guardian-session-query-sqlite
          name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-session-query-sqlite'
          config:
            path: ':memory:'
            openAt: first-search
        - id: bundled-session-guardian-tool-session-query
          name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-session-query'

    - id: bundled-session-guardian-trim
      name: session-guardian/trim
      disabled: !!js "!!ctx.get('profileContext')?.startedBundles?.includes('session-guardian')"

    # One compaction backend per context: upstream ships this row disabled and
    # leaves @deepseek-ai/dsh-compaction-basic in charge. A profile that wants
    # the retrieval backend enables this row and disables compaction-basic.
    - id: bundled-session-guardian-compaction
      name: session-guardian/compaction
      disabled: true

manifest.description: AI-agent-driven automated testing platform for DeepSeek Harness (dsh): Markdown case library, bug reports, per-project serial queue, development board and built-in load testing.

structuralInspection.patch:
# Touchstone dsh 插件包自带的组合行 —— bundle patch（2026-10-02 起）。
#
# 为什么行搬进包内而不是留在 profile patch:
#   dsh 的 Plugins 面板只把「包自带 patch 里 insert 出来的行」渲染成可开关的行
#   （dsh-plugin-manager 的 declaredRows(): 包未声明 dsh.bundle.patch 时 rows 为空），
#   手写在 profile cordis.patch.yml 里的 insert 在面板里既没有行也没有开关。
#   包内声明 + 在 profile 的 package.json 里把包名加进 dsh.profile.bundles 之后,
#   面板里就会出现 Touchstone 卡片与该行开关（开关写回 profile patch 的 disabled）。
#
# config 约定: repoDir 是**机器相关**路径（Touchstone 平台根，须含 webui/dist-plugin；
#   Python 后端入口为 backend_py/server.py，Node 后端入口为 backend/server.js），
#   不写死在这里 —— 由各 profile 的 cordis.patch.yml 用 `- id: touchstone-dsh` + `config:` 覆盖提供
#   （覆盖是整键替换，且 profile 层后于 bundle 层应用）。**2026-10-07 起 repoDir 可省**:
#   包已自包含（Node/Python 两版后端 + 预构建 webui/dist-plugin 都在包内），薄壳缺省回退到**包自身目录**
#   （lib/index.js 里 PACKAGE_DIR），只有要指向别的检出、或指定 pythonPath 时才写 config。
#   pythonPath 缺省 python3。
#
# name 必须是**完整包名**（与仓库根 package.json 的 name、scripts/build.mjs 生成的
# client.bundle.js 里的模块 id 三者逐字一致）；条目 id 是 touchstone-dsh（= 包名去掉 scope）。
# id 只是组合树里的**本地行键**（profile 覆盖行按它命中、Plugins 面板行开关按它写回），
# **不是包名**，改它必须与各 profile 的覆盖行同步 —— 否则覆盖落空（repoDir/pythonPath/disabled
# 全丢，回落包自身目录 + python3），面板开关还会在 profile patch 里追加一行、把旧行留成孤儿。
# 2026-10-09 由旧名 touchstone 改名（旧名是 2026-10-07 包改名前的残留）。
- insert:
    - id: touchstone-dsh
      name: "@gavinc-cn/touchstone-dsh"

# ── 第二行：自动提交守卫（id: dsh-autocommit，2026-11-01 并入本包）─────────────────
# 为什么它属于本包：这是 Touchstone 的**产品行为** —— 看板卡片一轮结束/挂起
# （agent/turn-stopping）时，把本会话改过的文件落成提交，卡片不会带着未提交改动停在那儿。
# 在此之前它以 @gavinc-cn/dsh-autocommit 独立组件包随 @gavinc-cn/dsh-plugins-runtime 分发；
# 并进本包后「装一个包就自带」：不用再单独装组件包，也不用跑内置资产安装。
#
# name 是本包的**子路径导出**（package.json 的 exports["./autocommit"] ⇒ dsh-plugin/autocommit/index.mjs）。
# 子路径当行名是 dsh 自己的既有形态（如 @deepseek-ai/dsh-plugin-manager/tools、
# @deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-subagent-control/list-agents）；client-modules 对子路径说明符直接判
# 「非 client 包」，所以它不会被当成第二个浏览器半，只加载宿主侧。
#

structuralInspection.patch:
# The dsh-storage-synapse bundle patch: Synapse pinning behind wallet-signed
# authentication.
#
# This layer inserts ONLY its own row. The wallet seam row (`id: wallet`)
# belongs to the dsh-wallet bundle, and the signing provider row to
# dsh-wallet-ethereum — install all three:
#
#   dsh plugin --profile <name> add /path/to/dsh-wallet /path/to/dsh-wallet-ethereum /path/to/dsh-storage-synapse
#
# (Patch layers each insert their own rows; a row id inserted by two layers
# would mount the plugin twice, so a bundle never restates another bundle's
# rows.) Until the wallet seam is present this plugin stays dormant — its
# `inject: [wallet, tools]` waits for the services instead of failing.
#
# `wallet` names the dsh-wallet entry that signs every node request; there is
# deliberately no key or credential field in this configuration.

- insert:
    - id: storage-synapse
      name: 'dsh-storage-synapse'
      config:
        wallet: agent
        # Filecoin Onchain Cloud only — no Kubo, no localhost:5001.
        # OWS wallet-gated (filecoin-pin 1.3.0 AccountConfig): viem Account
        # delegates signTransaction/signMessage to ctx.wallet (OWS vault xmtp-agent)
        # + treasury authorize/recordExpense — no privateKeyRef, no raw key.
        rpcUrl: https://api.calibration.node.glif.io/rpc/v1
        networkMode: calibration
        withCDN: false
        # filecoin-pin#615 workaround: calibration 2-copy replication fails, so one copy.
        # No exclusions by default: the endorsed set has been exactly [4, 9] and
        # excluding all of it fails every upload ("No endorsed provider
        # available"). Exclude a provider only with live evidence it is down;
        # the store path retries once without exclusions on selection failure.
        copies: 1
        excludeProviderIds: []

manifest.description: Economic survival engine for DeepSeek Harness: balances/expenses as storage-domain records, FUNDED/LOW/CRITICAL/DEPLETED as derived state, and a policy plugin that short-circuits agent/request and tools/pre-execute, metered off the token meter

structuralInspection.patch:
# The dsh-treasury bundle patch: the ledger (ctx.treasury) plus its
# enforcement policy, layered over dsh-base.
#
# PREREQUISITE — the storage stack. dsh-base does not mount the non-session
# storage hub; the ledger's `inject: [storageDomain]` keeps both rows dormant
# until a domain form is mounted. The dsh-web-app bundle mounts the stack
# already (ids: storage, storage-json, storage-domain); on a profile WITHOUT
# it (e.g. plain dsh-base or headless), add the same three rows to your
# profile's cordis.patch.yml — a bundle must not insert another bundle's row
# ids, or a web profile would mount them twice:
#
#   - insert:
#       - id: storage
#         name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-storage'
#       - id: storage-json
#         name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-storage-json'
#         config:
#           root: !!js dshHomePath('storages')
#       - id: storage-domain
#         name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-storage-domain'
#         config:
#           backend: json
#
# ENFORCEMENT ACTIVATION — disabled by default until a crypto-paying
# provider is configured. The ledger still meters Balances/expenses for
# accounting, but denies nothing while `enabled:false`. To enforce:
#   enabled: true
# Then fund it: await ctx.treasury.updateBalances([{ chain: 'ethereum',
#   token: 'USDC', amount: 250_000_000, usdEstimate: 250_000_000 }])
# `inferenceUsdPerMillionTokens` is your model's price (2000000 µUSD =
# $2.00/1M tokens) — keep 2000000 even while disabled so metering stays
# accurate once enabled.
#
# TOKEN METER PREREQUISITE — the policy prices requests through
# `ctx.tokenMeter`, which additionally requires the `session-projection` row
# (present in any profile that runs agents). Without it the meter — and
# therefore the policy — stays dormant and denies nothing.

- insert:
    - id: treasury
      name: 'dsh-treasury'
      config:
        burnWindowMs: 86400000
        fixedDailyBurnUsd: 0
        maxExpenses: 1000

    - id: treasury-policy
      name: 'dsh-treasury/policy'
      config:
        enabled: false
        inferenceUsdPerMillionTokens: 0
        defaultToolCostUsd: 0
        toolCosts: {}
        toolCategories: {}
        exemptTools: []

structuralInspection.patch:
# dsh-wallet-tools bundle: proper harness tools over ctx.wallet seam.
# Provides wallet_info tool so the model can answer "what is your address/balance/how to fund"
# via tool call, not static persona. Independent bundle, no patching other plugins.
# Live RPC: when liveBalances:true (default), get_balances {live:true} hits public
# RPCs (native fetch, sequential fallback per chain, isolated failures) and
# wallet_info adds a best-effort probe. Treasury remains durable cache; pass
# sync:true / refresh:true to persist live results via updateBalances so runway/state recompute.

        wallet: agent

manifest.name: @local/dsh-lazy-plugins
manifest.description: Load a plugin from the configured market index only when a task needs it, then release it.

structuralInspection.patch:
- insert:
    - id: dsh-lazy-plugins
      name: '@local/dsh-lazy-plugins'
      config:
        # 常驻（resident）不再靠手写名单：base bundle 结构性保护 + 本地使用分自动判定。
        # 这里只留「显式覆盖」名单，通常为空。
        # 默认激活方式：proxy = 当场可用且工具不进模型视野（前缀缓存不动）；now = 原生可见；session = 只装不启
        defaultActivate: proxy
        # 自动选取阈值（实测校准：31 条语料，40/1.3 精度 0.636 → 40/1.5 精度 0.80）
        autoSelectScore: 40
        autoSelectMargin: 1.5
        # 打开后同族（name/title 共享核心词）也视为判定明确：recall 0.167→~0.6，精度 0.80→~0.72
        autoSelectFamilyExempt: false
        # 双语桥接词权重（0.4 实测最优：P 0.900 / top5 0.900；0.6/0.8 各放行一次误装）
        bridgeWeight: 0.4
        # 同分类软加权（0=关；0.3 实测 P 不变、覆盖率翻倍）
        categoryBoost: 0.3
        resident: []
        halfLifeDays: 14
        residentScore: 3
        # 索引拉取：单次尝试只等首字节 5s，超时转下一个源；有磁盘缓存就先返回，
        # 后台按条件请求热更新覆盖缓存（304 时 0 字节）。
        fetchTimeoutMs: 3000
        bodyTimeoutMs: 20000
        refreshIntervalMs: 180000
        dailyRefreshMs: 86400000
        panelThrottleMs: 60000
        # 镜像顺序：实测可用（raw.githubusercontent 本机不可达，gcore 过慢，均已剔除）
        indexMirrors:
          - https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/jingjiangze/dsh-market@main/site/index.zh.json
        # 描述表来源（仓库里的 site 文档仍带 description），一次拉取 12h 有效
        descriptionSource: https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/jingjiangze/dsh-market@main/site/index.zh.json
        descriptionTtlMs: 43200000
        descriptionSearch: true
        # 装前可用性探测：命中时只问声明的 registry（1.5s），未命中才全量并行扫
        verifyInstall: true
        probeFastMs: 400
        probeTimeoutMs: 6000
        # 工具 schema 是否默认不进上下文（true 更省 token，但模型必须先发现这个工具）
        deferLoading: false
        # 索引磁盘缓存（跨进程复用；网络断开时旧副本仍可用）
        diskCache: true

Aggregate plugin bundle; no UI of its own, so no screenshots.
manifest.author: loyalchiiina

structuralInspection.patch:
# dsh-loyalchiiina-plugin-pack — 聚合 bundle 层（dsh.bundle.patch 指向本文件）
#
# 本包只做「按名挂载」：lib/index.js 只有 `export {}`，自身不注册任何服务、
# 工具、路由或 UI；所有行为都来自下面 insert 的 15 个独立子包。
#
# ── 两条硬约束 ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# 1) entry id 统一加 `suite-` 前缀。子包自带的 cordis.patch.yml 用的 id 就是
#    自己的包名（如 `dsh-artifact-linker`），若这里也用包名，用户一旦同时把
#    子包列进 dsh.profile.bundles，同一 id 会被两个层各插一次 → 触发
#    `duplicate loader entry id`（市场更新时被差分闸门回滚）。前缀化彻底规避。
# 2) 本文件只写 `insert:`，不写任何 `disabled:` / `config:` 覆盖。
#    所有子包一律跑各自默认配置（子包 patch 里的 config 块就是默认值镜像）。
#    要调参数：在 profile 级 cordis.patch.yml 里按 entry id 追加 config，
#    或者直接改本文件对应条目（改插件自己的 bundle patch 更稳）。
#
# ── 刻意不搬的两段（与 dsh-deepseek-web-free 自带 patch 的差异）────────────
# a) `agent-default-model` 的 provider/model 覆盖：那会把用户默认模型强行改成
#    deepseek-web，属于「替用户做选择」，聚合包不接管默认模型。
# b) `deepseek-web-free-tui`（name: dsh-deepseek-web-free/tui）：终端 UI 半边，
#    桌面端 / Web 端不需要；需要 TUI 的人单独装 dsh-deepseek-web-free。
# 因此本文件是 15 条 entry（一个组件一条），不是 17 条。
#
# ── 本地私有组件区（本地第 16 条，公开包里不存在）──────────────────────────
# `suite-skill-guard`（name: dsh-skill-guard）是本机私有组件：源码不进 npm、
# 也不写进 dependencies，只靠本目录下的 `node_modules/dsh-skill-guard` junction 解析。
# 公开 npm 包仍是 15 条 —— 发布前必须先跑 `node scripts/strip-private.mjs`，
# 由它生成剥离后的 `cordis.patch.public.yml` / `package.public.json`
# （只写新文件，绝不覆盖本地这两个文件）。
#
# ── 层序（决定「组件开关」怎么写）─────────────────────────────────────────
# 层顺序：bundle:* → user-patch → home-patch（后层按 id last-wins 覆盖）。
# 关掉某个组件：在 profile 的 cordis.patch.yml 里写
#     - id: suite-voice-alert
#       disabled: true

- insert:
    - id: suite-artifact-linker
      name: dsh-artifact-linker

    - id: suite-browser-hub
      name: dsh-browser-hub

    - id: suite-chat-image-lightbox
      name: dsh-chat-image-lightbox

    - id: suite-console-sentinel
      name: dsh-console-sentinel

    - id: suite-deepseek-web-free
      name: dsh-deepseek-web-free

    - id: suite-font-enhancer
      name: dsh-font-enhancer

    - id: suite-lit-fetch
      name: dsh-lit-fetch

    - id: suite-skill-browser
      name: dsh-skill-browser

    - id: suite-agent-team-auto-orchestrator
      name: dsh-agent-team-auto-orchestrator
      config:
        injectLaw: true
        enforceTeamGate: true
        gateMaxStrikes: 4

        gateDomains:

          - plugin
          - dsh

    - id: suite-todo-float-ball

manifest.name: dsh-ru-pii-guard
manifest.description: Reversible masking of Russian personal data and secrets in DSH model requests: the provider sees placeholders, the agent, tools and session log keep real values.
manifest.author: maburykh-gif

structuralInspection.patch:
# dsh-ru-pii-guard bundle patch: mounts the reverse-masking plugin into a dsh
# profile composition. It inserts one Host row; the plugin installs an
# undici.Dispatcher layer that masks Russian personal data and secrets in
# outgoing model requests and restores the originals in the response.
#
# Install: Settings -> Plugins in the Web UI, `dsh plugin add dsh-ru-pii-guard`,
# or `plugin_manager` with `action: install_bundle` and the package directory.
#
# Values below are the documented defaults (src/config.mjs `defaults`). A patch
# row replaces the whole `config` object of the row, so uncomment and keep only
# what differs from the defaults when overriding in the profile's own
# cordis.patch.yml.
- insert:
    - id: ru-pii-guard
      name: dsh-ru-pii-guard
      config:
        # Master switch. false (or mode: off) mounts nothing: no dispatcher,
        # no key, no audit files.
        enabled: true
        # enforce - mask the request and restore the response;
        # audit   - count matches and write the journal, but send the original
        #           request and leave the response untouched;
        # off     - same as enabled: false.
        mode: enforce
        # true: a masking failure blocks the request instead of sending it
        # unmasked (recommended). false: log the failure and pass the request
        # through unchanged.
        failClosed: true
        # Secret detectors ignore shorter values.
        minSecretLength: 8
        # Append a system note telling the model not to rewrite placeholders.
        promptHint: true
        # Restore originals in the model response. false keeps placeholders.
        restore: true
        # Plugin data directory. Empty -> <DSH_HOME>/pii-guard (key file and audit).
        dir: ''

        # Per-category switches for Russian identifiers. Set a key to false to
        # stop masking that category; src/core/types.mjs owns the full list.
        pii:
          snils: true
          inn: true
          ogrn: true
          ogrnip: true
          kpp: true
          bik: true
          account: true
          passport: true
          oms: true
          phone: true
          email: true
          card: true
          birthdate: true
          address: true
          fio: true

        # Secret detectors. cookies is off by default: Cookie headers are noisy
        # and often break provider requests when masked.
        secrets:
          apiKeys: true
          tokens: true
          passwords: true
          privateKeys: true
          secrets: true
          cookies: false

        # Values and regular expressions that must never be masked. Patterns are
        # JavaScript regex sources (uncompiled strings); malformed entries are
        # dropped with a warning.
        allowlist:
          values: []
          patterns: []
          # - 'example\\.invalid'
          # - '/^test-\\d+$/i'

        # Extra literal terms to mask (category TERM), e.g. project names.
        dictionary: []
        # - 'Project Aurora'

        # Hosts whose model traffic is left untouched, e.g. a local relay.
        excludeHosts: []
        # - 'localhost'

        # Audit journal: <audit.dir or data dir>/audit/YYYY-MM-DD.jsonl.
        # Entries carry category/placeholder/rule/valueFp (HMAC), never originals.
        audit:
          enabled: true
          # Delete journal files older than this many days (0 = keep forever).
          retentionDays: 90
          # Empty -> <data dir>/audit
          dir: ''

manifest.name: dsh-plugin-creator
manifest.description: Plugin-development toolkit for DeepSeek Harness: adds bundle and skill checks plus bundled skills to Creator mode only.

structuralInspection.patch:
# dsh-plugin-creator — bundle patch layer.
#
# This layer does exactly two things:
#
#   1. inserts one Host row for the bundle itself (registers nothing today), and
#   2. overrides the shipped Creator-mode preset (`preset-cordis`) so Creator mode
#      gains this bundle's tools and skills.
#
# Every other preset is untouched: the standard, ptc, minimal, and data-analysis
# declarations are neither patched nor restated, so this bundle cannot change what
# they compose. Removing the bundle removes this layer, the Creator-mode row
# falls back to the shipped `dsh-web-app` declaration, and the tools and skills
# below disappear with it.
#
# IMPORTANT — the preset override replaces the whole `config`; patches never
# deep-merge. The plugin list from `# --- shipped preset-cordis ---` to
# `# --- end shipped ---` is a verbatim copy of
# `@deepseek-ai/dsh-web-app/presets/cordis.patch.yml` at DSH 0.2.2-rc.5, with
# only the indentation shifted (the row is an override, not an insert).
# Re-copy that block after upgrading DSH, or Creator mode silently loses the
# shipped rows that the new version added.

- insert:
    - id: creator-host
      name: 'dsh-plugin-creator'

# --- shipped preset-cordis (verbatim, re-indented) ---
- id: preset-cordis
  name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-agent-preset'
  config:
    id: cordis
    order: 4
    plugins:
      # The dsh-doc skill owns plugin implementation and authorization guidance.
      - id: persona
        name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-persona'
        config:
          prefix: >-
            You are a coding agent powered by the {{model}} model.
            You help the user customize DeepSeek Harness itself.
      - id: agent-instructions
        name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-agent-instructions'
        config:
          maxBytes: 65536
      - id: time-context
        name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-time-context'
      - id: tool-bash
        name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-bash'
        disabled: !!js process.platform === 'win32'
      - id: tool-pwsh
        name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-pwsh'
        disabled: !!js process.platform !== 'win32'
      - id: tool-fs
        name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-fs'
        config:
          # Set true to add the apply_patch tool beside edit.
          applyPatch: false
      - id: tool-fs-search
        name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-fs-search'
        config:
          sampleOverCapGlobResults: false
      - id: tool-jobs
        name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-jobs'
      - id: tool-schedule
        name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-schedule'
      - id: command-goal
        name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-command-goal'
      - id: tool-goal
        name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-goal'
      - id: planning
        name: cordis:group
        group: true
        isolate:
          planMode: true
        config:
          - id: plan-mode
            name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-plan-mode'
            config:
              section: |
                You are in plan mode. Stay in plan mode until the user approves your plan through exit_plan_mode or switches the session mode. Imperative language to implement changes means plan the implementation, not execute it. A user's conversational agreement — including an answer confirming something you asked — approves nothing and does not end plan mode; fold the confirmed decision into the plan and submit it through exit_plan_mode.

                Explore first. Use non-mutating reads, searches, static analysis, and checks to ground the plan in the actual repository. Do not edit or write files, change configuration, run formatters or code generation that rewrites tracked files, commit, or otherwise carry out the plan. Prefer existing functions and patterns over new machinery.

                The tool catalog stays the same across modes for request-cache stability. These plan-mode rules override any later tool description or guidance that suggests using mutation tools; those tools remain listed to keep the tool catalog unchanged. Do not use todo_write to track this planning phase: it tracks implementation after an approved plan, while the plan itself belongs in exit_plan_mode.

                Resolve discoverable facts by inspection. Use ask_user_question only for user-owned choices or material ambiguity that inspection cannot answer. Do not ask the user where code lives or how current behavior works when you can find out.

                Make the plan decision-complete: state the goal and success criteria; group implementation changes by subsystem; identify public API, schema, and data-flow changes; cover edge cases, failure modes, tests, acceptance criteria, and explicit assumptions. Keep it concise enough to review but detailed enough that another engineer can implement it without making design decisions.

                When ready, call exit_plan_mode with the complete plan markdown, starting with a # title. Make exit_plan_mode the only and final tool call in that assistant response: it presents the plan for approval, and implementation begins only in a later step after approval. Do not paste the final plan as a plain reply or ask "should I proceed?" through prose or ask_user_question. If review rejects it, incorporate the feedback and present again. If the review channel is unavailable or aborted, stay in plan mode and ask the user to switch modes manually; do not proceed with implementation.
      - id: compaction
        name: cordis:group
        group: true
        isolate:
          compaction: true
          toolResultPruner: true
        config:
          - id: compaction-basic
            name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-compaction-basic'
          - id: command-compact
            name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-command-compact'
          - id: tool-result-pruner
            name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-compaction-tool-result-pruner'
            config:
              thresholdChars: 8192
              headChars: 4096
              tailChars: 1024
      - id: delegation
        name: cordis:group
        group: true
        isolate:
          workflowEngine: true
        config:
          - id: tool-subagent-control
            name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-subagent-control'
            config:
              interrupt: false
          - id: tool-subagent
            name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-subagent'
            config:
              provider: spawn
              toolName: subagent
              modelSelection: true
              modelDiscovery: true
          - id: tool-subagent-fork
            name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-subagent'
            config:
              provider: fork
              toolName: subagent_fork
          - id: workflow-ptc
            name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-workflow-ptc'
            config:
              provider: spawn
          - id: tool-workflow
            name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-workflow'
      - id: tool-ask-user
        name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-ask-user'
      - id: tool-todo
        name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-todo'
        config:
          allowParallelInProgress: true
      - id: tool-web
        name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-web'
        config:
          fetch: true
          searchTimeoutMs: 60000
      - id: tool-cordis
        name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-cordis'
      - id: skill-filesystem
        name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-skill-filesystem'
        config:
          customSkillDirs:
            - !!js process.getBuiltinModule('node:path').join(process.getBuiltinModule('node:path').dirname(process.getBuiltinModule('node:module').createRequire(baseUrl).resolve('@deepseek-ai/dsh-agent-preset/package.json')), 'skills')
      - id: tool-skill
        name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-skill'
      - id: present
        name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-present'
      - id: tool-plugin-manager
        name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-plugin-manager/tools'
        disabled: !!js "!ctx.get('profileContext')"
      - id: tool-plugin-market
        name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-plugin-market/tools'
        disabled: !!js "!ctx.get('profileContext')"
      # --- end shipped ---

      # --- dsh-plugin-creator additions (Creator mode only) ---

      # Tools: `./tools` registers dsh_plugin_check on this preset's context.
      - id: creator-tools
        name: 'dsh-plugin-creator/tools'

      # Skills: a second filesystem provider, isolated to this package's own
      # `skills/` directory. `includeDefaultRoots: false` keeps it from
      # re-scanning the project and user roots that the shipped provider owns.
      - id: creator-skills
        name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-skill-filesystem'
        config:
          providerName: creator
          includeDefaultRoots: false
          customSkillDirs:
            - !!js process.getBuiltinModule('node:path').join(process.getBuiltinModule('node:path').dirname(process.getBuiltinModule('node:module').createRequire(baseUrl).resolve('dsh-plugin-creator/package.json')), 'skills')

manifest.name: @local/dsh-nexus-memory
manifest.description: Native Nexus Memory plugin for the Harness: auto-recall before a turn, auto-capture after it.

structuralInspection.patch:
- insert:
    - id: nexus-memory
      name: '@local/dsh-nexus-memory'
      config:
        # --- transport: redet HTTP mit einem laufenden `nexus-memory serve` ---
        transport: http
        baseUrl: 'http://127.0.0.1:9122'
        keyFile: '~/.nexus-memory/service_auth.key'
        accessLevel: private
        captureCategory: session

        # --- Auto-Recall ---
        # Drei Eintraege statt fuenf (Messung 20.11.2026 an 25 echten Fragen:
        # fuenf Eintraege brachten 2,96 unpassende je Nachricht, drei 1,76).
        # Diese Datei ueberschreibt die Vorgabe im Code, deshalb steht die Zahl
        # hier und nicht nur in index.js. Ausschluss statt Erlaubnisliste:
        # Protokolle (session) und Etiketten (entity) bleiben draussen, Wissen
        # wie lesson/pattern/procedure kommt durch. Mindestpunktzahl bleibt aus.
        recall: true
        recallLimit: 3
        recallExcludeCategories:
          - session
          - entity
        recallBudgetChars: 1600
        recallTimeoutMs: 4000

        # --- Auto-Capture ---
        capture: true
        captureMinChars: 12
        captureMaxChars: 1600
        captureSubagents: false

        # --- Fallback ohne Daemon: transport: stdio --------------------------
        # Nur noetig, wenn kein nexus-memory-Dienst laeuft, aber das Python-Paket

        # embeddingProvider: ollama

    # --- Werkzeuge: recall, remember, forget, fact_history, report, health ----
    # Der Harness bringt einen MCP-Client mit; damit werden die Nexus-Werkzeuge zu
    # echten Werkzeugen des Agenten, nicht nur zu automatischem Erinnern.

structuralInspection.patch:
# dsh-tradewatcher bundle patch —— **九行形态**：聚合包 + 可单独开关的子组件。
#
# 九行 = 一个内核行 + 八个功能行，全部 `name: 'dsh-tradewatcher'`（**同一个包、同一个加载源**），
# 靠 **`id` 前缀**区分、由 `config.row` 决定这一行注册哪一段（代码见 src/index.ts:32-64、:219-266）：
#   tradewatcher-core      → row: core       内核：store/rescue 采样、共享路由（行情/详情图/云图/备份…）、
#                                            `GET /tradewatcher/rows`、核心 agent 工具
#   tradewatcher-calendar  → row: calendar   `/tradewatcher/calendar` + `tradewatcher_calendar`/`_calendar_add`
#   tradewatcher-watchlist → row: watchlist  `/tradewatcher/watch|industries|anomaly` + `_watchlist`/`_group_rank`
#   tradewatcher-portfolio → row: portfolio  `/tradewatcher/portfolio|ledger` + `_portfolio`/`_ledger`
#   tradewatcher-market    → row: market     `/tradewatcher/breadth|rescue|board|market-extras` + `_rescue`
#   tradewatcher-cloudmap  → row: cloudmap   纯客户端 iframe（host 侧无独占路由/工具，只贡献 activeRows）
#   tradewatcher-tools     → row: tools      **工具箱**（工具目录页 + 工具详情页）+
#                                            `/tradewatcher/tools/global-flow`（五市场蛋糕的数据；**只被工具箱页消费**
#                                            ⇒ 按 §2.2 判据归本行，v0.72.0 起它确实独占了一条路由）+
#                                            `/tradewatcher/leverage`（杠杆温度计；只被工具页的 leverage 详情消费，
#                                            v0.116.0 起归本行；契约：永远 200、缺数据一律 null）。
#                                            本行不带 agent 工具；与 cloudmap 一样贡献 activeRows ⇒ 页签门控照常工作。
#   tradewatcher-fupan     → row: fupan      **复盘**（第 8 行，v0.111.0）：复盘页签（月历 + 当日笔记 + 钉到未来日期
#                                            + 当日交易记录）+
#                                            `/tradewatcher/fupan/month` `/tradewatcher/fupan/note` `/tradewatcher/fupan/trades`
#                                            （只被复盘页消费 ⇒ 按 §2.2 判据归本行；数据是本地笔记文件、
#                                            既有交易日历与既有流水，零新增上游请求；本行同样不带 agent 工具）。
#   tradewatcher-prism     → row: prism      **棱镜**（第 9 行，v0.130.0）：研判时点 + 金十 24h 快讯 + 4+1 研判；
#                                            `/tradewatcher/prism`（GET=状态；POST action=settings/skeleton/news/run/capital/copy/cancel/match）
#                                            `/tradewatcher/prism/selftest`（真实调一次 ctx.llm.stream，永远 200）
#                                            （只被棱镜页消费 ⇒ 按 §2.2 判据归本行；本行不带 agent 工具）。
#
# ⚠ **历史归因纠正（这一条要读，前一轮的结论是错的）** —— 这段说的是当时的**六行**形态，七行是同机制加一行。
# v0.50.0 曾把"（六行）装载失败"归因成"同一 package 多个活跃 Loader 源 = composition error"，
# **该归因不成立**：
#   ① DSH 原文是 "distinct active Loader **sources** for that package are a composition error"
#      （@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-modules/lib/index.js:122-123）。这里的 source 指**解析源**
#      （`sourceKey = baseUrl + "\0" + loaderName`，:791-792）：:833-840 把同名行按 sourceKey
#      收进 `Map` ⇒ **多行同名 + 同 baseUrl ⇒ 只有一个 sourceKey ⇒ 永远走不到 :873 的报错**。
#   ② 真正打死它的是 `apply` 里读了 `ctx.config`：真宿主的 ctx 是 Cordis Proxy，**访问未 inject
#      的属性直接抛**（@deepseek-ai/cordis/lib/index.js:676 `cannot get property "config" without inject`）
#      ⇒ 那一行 fiber failed，用户端表现为"插件服务异常"。**这个 bug 与行数无关：1 行和 N 行同样被打死。**
#      v0.45.3 已修（只读第二参数 `config` + `ctxSafe` 包住 `ctx.config`，src/index.ts:85-91、:268-270）。
#   ⇒ 结论：**多行方案在那之前从未被真正验证过**，v0.59.0 起重做（完整证据链见 docs/AUDIT-IMPL35.md）。
#
# 行语义（`rowOf`，src/index.ts:118-125）：
#   · 不带 config        ⇒ `all`：全量注册（**与拆分前逐字一致**；老 profile 的单行靠这条）
#   · `config: { row: <行名> }` ⇒ 只注册该行那一段（行未激活 ⇒ 路由/工具都不注册，天然 404）
#   · 认不出的 row 值    ⇒ 回退 `all`（宁可多给，不可少给）
#
# 单独关掉某一行：**不要改本文件**，在 profile 层
# (`~/.dsh/profiles/<profile>/cordis.patch.yml`) 按 id 覆盖即可，例如只关日历：
#   - id: tradewatcher-calendar
#     disabled: true
# 关掉工具箱同理：`- id: tradewatcher-tools` + `disabled: true` ⇒ `GET /tradewatcher/rows` 不含 `tools`
# ⇒ 客户端 `gateTabs` 直接不渲染「工具」页签（门控是既有逻辑，见 src/client/tabsGate.ts）。
# ⚠ 改完 **必须重启 `dsh web`** —— 宿主行只在启动时装载，**刷新页面不够**。
#
# 回退成单行（用户端若再次异常）：见 docs/AUDIT-IMPL35.md 的「回滚」一节（一条命令）。
# 行**标题**（插件列表里显示什么）与「为什么 core 必须留在裸包名上」：
#   · 列表标题取自 `row.meta.title`（没有 meta 时回退 `moduleShortName(name)`）；meta 由 `readPluginMeta(specifier, base)`
#     解析：**`<specifier>/locale/{en,zh}.json`** 里的 `meta.title` / `meta.description`（@deepseek-ai/dsh-app-boot）。
#   · ⚠ 硬约束：`dsh-client-modules` 只把**裸包名**当成「客户端半区加载源」——`exactPackageSpecifier()` 对含 `/` 的
#     **非 scoped** specifier 返回 undefined（`lib/index.js:82-88`，配合 `:746-747` 的 `return void 0`）⇒ 子路径行**不是** client source。
#     所以**必须有且只有一行保持裸包名**（本文件的 `tradewatcher-core`），否则浏览器半区**整体不注册**：
#     TCP 路由照样 200、`/rows` 照样有行数，**但界面直接没了**（实测：全用子路径时，`window.__DSH_BOOT__` 里 `dsh-tradewatcher` 出现 0 次）。
#   · 其余七行用 `dsh-tradewatcher/rows/<row>`：正好不参与 client 注册（也就不会触发「多个 source」），但各自能解析自己的 locale ⇒ 标题可区分。
#   · 一句话：**八行不能都给子路径；core 必须留在裸包名 `dsh-tradewatcher` 上。**
- insert:
    - id: tradewatcher-core
      name: 'dsh-tradewatcher'
      config: { row: core }
    - id: tradewatcher-calendar
      name: 'dsh-tradewatcher/rows/calendar'
      config: { row: calendar }
    - id: tradewatcher-watchlist
      name: 'dsh-tradewatcher/rows/watchlist'
      config: { row: watchlist }
    - id: tradewatcher-portfolio
      name: 'dsh-tradewatcher/rows/portfolio'
      config: { row: portfolio }
    - id: tradewatcher-market
      name: 'dsh-tradewatcher/rows/market'
      config: { row: market }
    - id: tradewatcher-cloudmap
      name: 'dsh-tradewatcher/rows/cloudmap'
      config: { row: cloudmap }
    # 工具箱：工具目录页 + 工具详情页（客户端半区）；host 侧本轮无独占路由/工具
    - id: tradewatcher-tools
      name: 'dsh-tradewatcher/rows/tools'
      config: { row: tools }
    # 复盘（第 8 行）：复盘页签 + 本地笔记与当日交易记录的三条路由
    # （`/tradewatcher/fupan/month`、`/tradewatcher/fupan/note`、`/tradewatcher/fupan/trades`）
    - id: tradewatcher-fupan
      name: 'dsh-tradewatcher/rows/fupan'
      config: { row: fupan }
    # 棱镜（第 9 行）：研判时点（cron 语义的自研节拍）+ 金十 24h 快讯 + 4+1 研判；只读页面 + 两个编辑面

      name: 'dsh-tradewatcher/rows/prism'
      config: { row: prism }
