manifest.name: @xi4z/dsh-utils
manifest.description: DeepSeek Harness utility bundle: a patch-only package that assembles six independently published components — the utils-agents preset/skill panel (nested SKILL.md discovery, model visibilities, skills, repositories and AGENTS.md), an unattended approval gate, a QQ approval card answerer, session notifications, a loopback reverse-proxy entry for an operator-owned tunnel, and the shared browser UI that configures every row.
manifest.author: xi4z

scripts.test: pnpm build && node --check packages/ui/client.js && node --test test/*.test.mjs && pnpm -r --filter "./packages/*" run test

structuralInspection.patch:
# dsh-utils — bundle layer for the utility components.
#
# This package mounts no component of its own: it is the same shape as the
# shipped experimental bundles. Every component is an independently published
# package (a real dependency of this bundle), and this patch assembles them:
#
#   dsh-approval-policy  — unattended approval gate: subagent/scheduled/cron
#                          approval requests wait a bounded window, then settle
#                          with a fail-closed default instead of hanging forever.
#   dsh-notify           — session notifications: a turn ending, a pending
#                          approval, or a pending question is pushed through a
#                          Gotify gateway, tagged with this device's name.
#   utils-agents         — the one host component for skills and presets. It
#                          registers each ~/.dsh/.agent-presets/<id>/ directory
#                          as a real agent preset through cordis:include, serves
#                          routes that list/toggle its skills, edit its
#                          Markdown, and clone/fast-forward a Git repository
#                          (public or private, via a Deploy Key) into it — and
#                          it also owns recursive nested SKILL.md discovery plus
#                          the model-facing skill visibility switches, merged
#                          from the former utils-main and dsh-skill-panel rows.
#   dsh-remote           — loopback reverse-proxy entry for an operator-owned
#                          tunnel: rewrites Host/Origin/Referer to the loopback
#                          authority, relays HTTP/SSE/WebSocket, and on a
#                          desktop profile keeps the stock desktop UI while
#                          answering the first 401 on GET / with the tokenized
#                          URL the Host itself minted (the desktop shell never
#                          prints one). Holds no credential and forges no cookie.
#   utils-ui             — the browser half shared by every row above: the
#                          configuration page for each row and the utils-agents
#                          sidebar panel. Its host half is an empty marker; the
#                          client module scanner serves its client.js because
#                          this row mounts the bare package name.
#
# Row ids double as settings namespaces and stay stable. The plugin page keeps
# addressing each row's configuration as `@xi4z/dsh-utils#<row id>`, because
# this bundle is the package that inserted the row.

- insert:
    - id: dsh-approval-policy
      name: '@xi4z/dsh-utils-approval-policy'
      config: {}
    - id: dsh-approval-qq
      name: '@xi4z/dsh-utils-approval-qq'
      config:
        # 默认关闭：填好 relay 地址与共享密钥后再打开。
        enabled: false
        # relay 的审批基地址（HTTPS 反代到 relay 的 /approval 端点），
        # 例如 https://notify.xiaz.work/_qq/approval。
        relayUrl: ''
        # relay 侧鉴权：relay 没配 approval.key 时复用 gotify.clientToken，这里填同一把。
        sharedKey: ''
        deviceLabel: ''
        # 自动裁决（auto review / GUI 抢答）落在防抖窗口内时不出卡。
        sendDelayMs: 1200
        includeSubagents: true
    - id: dsh-notify
      name: '@xi4z/dsh-utils-notify'
      config:
        # 留空 = 内置默认。下面只列出最常改的几项，完整字段见 README。
        #
        # 出口：Gotify 网关。网关地址可写 '${VAR}'（投递前展开）；token 是只写密钥，
        # 只认字面量，不做 ${ENV} 插值。想把 token 放在环境变量里，用 targets[].tokenEnv：
        #   targets:
        #     - name: qq-home
        #       url: 'https://notify.example.com'
        #       tokenEnv: DSH_GOTIFY_TOKEN
        transport: gotify
        # token 从 Gotify 直接复制；全角标点（。）、大写前缀或漏掉的点会在投递前自动纠正。
        # 先只记日志：确认能收到再改成 false（或在 profile patch 里覆盖）。
        dryRun: true
        # 设备名留空 = 自动取主机名；deviceLabel 是渲染到 {device} 的显示名。
        deviceName: ''
        deviceLabel: ''
        notifyOnReasons:
          - completed
          - error
          - aborted
        notifyOnApproval: true
        notifyOnQuestion: true
    - id: utils-agents
      name: '@xi4z/dsh-utils-utils-agents'
      config:
        # 单文件读写上限（字节）。AGENTS.md 本质上也是提示词，别放太大。
        maxBytes: 524288
        # 额外的预设根目录；每个子目录是一个预设。
        presetDirs: []
        # 额外的共享预设来源（技能仓库）；读取其 .dsh 下的预设，供面板同步。
        presetSourceDirs: []
        # 保留为原生的预设 id；其余原生声明可导入成目录预设并发布到共享仓库。
        builtinPresets:
          - standard
          - ptc
          - minimal
          - creator
        # 全局 / 项目 AGENTS.md 视图的额外文件与递归扫描。
        extraAgentsFiles: []
        scanNestedAgents: false
        nestedDepth: 3
        # 新预设技能仓库的默认值。
        defaultRepoUrl: 'https://github.com/xi4z/skills'
        defaultBranch: 'Agent'
        # 嵌套 SKILL.md 递归发现（原 utils-main 行）。
        minDepth: 2
        maxDepth: 8
        watch: true
        includeProjectRoots: true
        includeUserRoots: true
        extraRoots: []
        ignoreDirs:
          - .system
          - node_modules
          - .git
        # 模型技能目录里隐藏的技能名（原 dsh-skill-panel 行）；仍可手动加载。
        disabledSkills: []
        # 面板顶部的版本检查：定时查询 npm 上 @xi4z/dsh-utils 的 latest。
        # 手动「检查更新」按钮不受间隔限制；改镜像时把 updateRegistry 换掉。
        updateCheck: true
        updateCheckIntervalHours: 6
        updateRegistry: 'https://registry.npmjs.org'
        # 查到新版本就后台 pnpm add；装完要重启 dsh web。link:/file: 安装自动跳过。
        updateAutoInstall: true
    - id: dsh-remote
      name: '@xi4z/dsh-utils-remote'
      config:
        # 默认关闭：这是给「自备隧道」用的入口，先填 publicUrl 再打开。
        enabled: false
        # 隧道转发到本机这个端口；代理自己只监听回环。
        listenHost: 127.0.0.1
        listenPort: 3079
        # 公网 HTTPS 根地址，如 https://dsh.example.com/。
        # desktop profile 首次未登录时会 302 到宿主自己签发的带 token 地址。
        publicUrl: ''
        # auto：desktop 走 preserve-desktop-ui（原版桌面界面 + 宿主自举鉴权），
        # web 走 passthrough（你自己用启动行打印的 token 地址登录）。
        strategy: auto
        autoBootstrap: true
        # 非回环监听是非默认行为，确有必要才打开。
        allowRemoteListen: false
        bootstrapMaxPerMinute: 6
        # 把宿主刚签发的 dsh-auth-* cookie 回显到日志（它是一枚活的会话凭据，
        # 只写本机日志；不想留痕就关掉）。
        logAuthCookie: true
    - id: utils-ui
      name: '@xi4z/dsh-utils-ui'

manifest.description: Lead mode for DSH: two agent presets (PTC and creation), a working-method skill, a team digest skill, a dependency self-check, and two opening reminders that tell you to enable the official Agent Teams. | 给 DSH 加 Lead 模式：PTC 与创造两个预置、两个 skill、依赖自检、两条开场提示。

scripts.check: node --check lib/index.js && node scripts/validate-names.mjs --manifest ./dsh-plugin.naming.json && node scripts/check-patch.mjs

structuralInspection.patch:
# dsh-lead-mode bundle patch
#
# Three inserts.
#
# 1. `dsh-lead-mode` — this plugin's own host half. It registers the bundled
#    runtime skills, the `/lead-mode` slash command, and the startup check that
#    warns when the Team runtime is missing. The loader id equals the package
#    name, matching `dsh-plugin.naming.json` (`names.loaderIds`).
# 2. `preset-lead-ptc` — the Lead preset for PTC sessions. Its
#    `config.plugins` mirrors the official `ptc` preset row for row; the only
#    difference is the persona prefix, which switches the session into Lead mode,
#    states the Agent Teams prerequisite up front, and tells the model to pick
#    delegation models from `list_subagent_models` instead of inventing ids.
#    PTC means only `run_code` is callable directly; every other tool is an SDK
#    binding called inside the program.
# 3. `preset-lead-cordis` — the Lead preset for creator work (the official
#    `cordis` preset's shape). Same persona; rows mirror `cordis` except for one
#    documented delta: the official `skill-filesystem` row carries
#    `customSkillDirs` computed from the patch file's `baseUrl`, and that
#    expression cannot resolve the host package from this plugin's directory, so
#    the row is mounted without it. Consequence: the `dsh-doc` skill is not in
#    this preset's filesystem skill dirs.
#
# Both presets keep the same tool rows as their official counterparts because the
# Lead layer is method, not capability: it adds no tools, only the persona. Any
# row added here would be a capability change the official preset does not have.
#
# This plugin does NOT mount the Team runtime. There are two generations of it,
# and they are turned on in completely different ways:
#
# - Old generation (host up to 0.2.2-rc.1, the currently published line):
#   `@deepseek-ai/dsh-experimental-tool-agent-team` listens on the global
#   `agent/created` event and installs Team tools on every agent, so it belongs to
#   the host plane, not to a preset row. Users turn it on with the official
#   profile package:
#
#     dsh plugin --profile <name> add @deepseek-ai/dsh-experimental-agent-team-profile@0.2.2-rc.1
#
#   The version pin matters: bare `npm i` resolves `latest`, which is 0.1.5-alpha.2
#   and does not mount on a 0.2.2 host. `next` points at 0.2.2-rc.1. The pin must
#   equal the host version (`dsh --version`): the team packages pin exact `dsh-*`
#   peers, so a profile built for an older rc installs peers this host does not
#   satisfy.
#
# - New generation (0.2.2-rc.3 and later): Team tools ship with the base and web
#   bundles, and a teammate is just a `subagent`. Nothing is installed. Users flip
#   the per-session switch 「开启智能体团队协作」 in the model & reasoning menu. The
#   profile package above is now in `RETIRED_BUNDLES`, and app-boot deletes it
#   from a profile, so the install command must never be shown to a user on a new
#   host.
#
# The persona prefix below does not decide the generation: it points at the
# `lead-mode` skill and checks `team_task_*` to see whether Team is on. The
# generation comes from the skill's §2.2, which reads the session's tool list.

- insert:
    - id: dsh-lead-mode
      name: 'dsh-lead-mode'
    - id: preset-lead-ptc
      name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-agent-preset'
      config:
        id: lead-ptc
        name: Lead · PTC
        description: 只决策、拆活、派活、验收。PTC 会话：只有 run_code 能直调。需要先开 dsh 官方 Agent Teams。
        order: 5
        plugins:
          - id: persona
            name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-persona'
            config:
              prefix: |
                你是 Lead：只做决策、拆活、派活，不自己写代码、不改文件；调查与验收都派成员，结论由你判断并讲给用户。先保主目标，枝节记遗留；判据要具体，退回返工不自己补位。

                派活前加载 `lead-mode` skill：Agent Teams 两代差异、从零或继承、挑模型、任务板、写作用域、并行、验收、长程止损、难度升级，都在里面。

                派活先 `list_subagent_models` 挑 provider/model 成对，别编造 id；只有一条跟随父模型。

                派完活结束回合等通知，不 `wait_agent`、不轮询，叫成员用 `send_message`；值得并行的活一次派完，别一件一件等。

                开局先确认 Team 开没开：PTC 查 SDK 块有没有 `team_task_*`，其他看工具清单。没有就停手，别自己干完或拿 subagent 顶替 teammate，让用户敲 `/lead-mode`。

                派活要求成员第一步建 `.scratch/<effort>/worklog-<mate>.md`，收尾前补完最后一轮。
          - id: agent-instructions
            name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-agent-instructions'
            config:
              maxBytes: 65536
          - id: time-context
            name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-time-context'
          - id: tool-bash
            name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-bash'
            disabled: !!js process.platform === 'win32'
          - id: tool-pwsh
            name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-pwsh'
            disabled: !!js process.platform !== 'win32'
          - id: tool-fs
            name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-fs'
            config:
              # 0.2.2 起 apply_patch 默认开启。官方预置显式关掉，这里跟着关。
              applyPatch: false
          - id: tool-fs-search
            name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-fs-search'
            config:
              sampleOverCapGlobResults: false
          - id: tool-jobs
            name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-jobs'
          - id: tool-schedule
            name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-schedule'
          - id: skill-filesystem
            name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-skill-filesystem'
          - id: tool-skill
            name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-skill'
          - id: command-goal
            name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-command-goal'
          - id: tool-goal
            name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-goal'
          - id: planning
            name: cordis:group
            group: true
            isolate:
              planMode: true
            config:
              - id: plan-mode
                name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-plan-mode'
                config:
                  section: |
                    You are in plan mode. Stay in plan mode until the user approves your plan through exit_plan_mode or switches the session mode. Imperative language to implement changes means plan the implementation, not execute it. A user's conversational agreement — including an answer confirming something you asked — approves nothing and does not end plan mode; fold the confirmed decision into the plan and submit it through exit_plan_mode.

                    Explore first. Use non-mutating reads, searches, static analysis, and checks to ground the plan in the actual repository. Do not edit or write files, change configuration, run formatters or code generation that rewrites tracked files, commit, or otherwise carry out the plan. Prefer existing functions and patterns over new machinery.

                    The tool catalog stays the same across modes for request-cache stability. These plan-mode rules override any later tool description or guidance that suggests using mutation tools; those tools remain listed to keep the tool catalog unchanged.                     Resolve discoverable facts by inspection. Use ask_user_question only for user-owned choices or material ambiguity that inspection cannot answer. Do not ask the user where code lives or how current behavior works when you can find out.

          - id: delegation

            config:

          - id: tool-executor-ptc
            name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-executor-ptc'
          - id: present
            name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-present'
          - id: tool-office
            name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-office'
          - id: tool-plugin-manager
            name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-plugin-manager/tools'
            disabled: true

manifest.name: @joshin/dsh-drop-by
manifest.description: 主动陪伴插件：沿用你的人设，挑合适时机主动来聊；有独立作息、会自己搜网页看视频，也能识别收尾信号不硬聊。新装默认 DSH 内部会话开箱即用，可随时切到 QQ 或抖音私信并共用同一会话，支持私聊派任务与约定提醒。QQ/抖音入口需分别配合 dsh-plugin-qq-bridge / dsh-douyin-scroll。

structuralInspection.patch:
# dsh-drop-by 的 bundle 补丁层：把插件作为一行插进 dsh profile 的条目列表。
#
# 两条安装路径都会用到这一行：
#   1) 本地 link（开发用）：profile/package.json 里加 "dsh-drop-by": "link:<本目录>"，
#      再把 "dsh-drop-by" 加进 dsh.profile.bundles —— 这层 patch 会自动进层栈；
#   2) 直接手动挂：profile/node_modules 里放一个指向本目录的 junction，然后在
#      profile 的 cordis.patch.yml 里 insert 同样的一行（见 README「装成 dsh 插件」）。
#
# name 必须是**裸包名**，不能写子路径。
- insert:
    - id: dsh-drop-by
      name: '@joshin/dsh-drop-by'
      config:
        # 总开关。false = 插件照样激活但一拍都不跑（方便临时停掉而不卸载）
        enabled: true
        # 用宿主自己的模型生成（ctx.llm）。false = 退回 llm.js，spawn 一个 dsh CLI
        hostLlm: true
        # GET /api/dsh-drop-by/state、POST /api/dsh-drop-by/tick
        statusApi: true
        # 给模型一个 presence_status 工具（问「你还在盯着我吗」时才用）
        tool: true
        # 宿主起来后先等这么久再跑第一拍
        startupDelaySec: 60
        # 每拍随机抖 0~N 秒，别每次都在整点同一秒打模型
        jitterSec: 30

structuralInspection.patch:
# dsh-background-task-engine bundle patch.
#
# The patch registers the plugin into a profile. `plugin_manager install_bundle`
# appends this row to the profile's cordis.patch.yml and installs the package.
#
# `config` mirrors src/config.ts (Schemastery). Every value below is validated
# again at load time; out-of-range values fail the plugin load instead of being
# silently clamped.
- insert:
    - id: background-task-engine
      name: 'dsh-background-task-engine'
      config:
        maxTasksPerOwner: 100
        maxStepsPerTask: 10
        maxActiveRunsPerOwner: 3
        maxParallelRunsPerTask: 1
        defaultTimeoutMinutes: 60
        staleRunAfterMinutes: 30
        historyRetentionDays: 90
        maxSummaryChars: 2000
